articles.title: GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic
articles.descEn: Since GPT-5.6 Sol launched in early July, OpenAI says revenue is up 35 percent this quarter, with enterprise revenue growing more than 50 percent. Ramp data shows OpenAI outpacing Anthropic in business API spending for the first time after Anthropic had overtaken OpenAI in quarterly revenue.
articles.titleEn: GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic pulled in $11.6 billion compared to OpenAI's $6.7 billion, as the Wall Street Journal reported .
Before GPT-5.6 Sol launched, Anthropic had reached a $65 billion annualized revenue run rate and overtaken OpenAI in quarterly revenue for the first time, according to Bloomberg .
Growth had slowed at both labs , partly because open-weight models were gaining ground.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background
articles.descEn: OpenAI is previewing transparent background support for GPT-Image-2 through its API. The alpha channel gets baked in during image generation, which according to OpenAI beats conventional background removal. A single parameter activates the feature.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI is previewing transparent background support for GPT-Image-2 through its API.
According to OpenAI, baking the alpha channel in during generation produces better results than conventional background removal, especially on tricky areas like transparent glass or thin fibers.
OpenAI recommends leaving background descriptions out of the prompt, since the model may still generate one otherwise.

articles.title: ChatGPT on Mac can now read and respond to Apple iMessages - Engadget
articles.descEn: OpenAI has rolled out a plugin that allows ChatGPT to control the Apple Messages app.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT on Mac can now read and respond to Apple iMessages - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: First, they'll have to allow ChatGPT to access their Mac's on-device Messages history when the permissions screen pops up during the setup process.
OpenAI has launched a plugin for the Apple Messages app, and as Bloomberg notes, it could raise privacy and security concerns.
In 2024, for instance, it kept disabling Beeper Mini chat app's access to iMessage until Beeper gave up rolling out fixes that re-enabled the integration.

articles.title: A low-tech solution from the past may be your best defense against AI deepfakes
articles.descEn: AI-enabled identity theft is getting too sophisticated to have predictable tells anymore, so experts recommend answering with a seemingly old-fashioned approach.
articles.titleEn: A low-tech solution from the past may be your best defense against AI deepfakes
summaryLinesEn: This call resulted in 15 wire transfers to third-party accounts totaling about $25m .
Also: AI image fraud will cost $40 billion next year - can these international standards help?

Also: OpenAI's attack agent did exactly what it was told - just more relentlessly than expected "Make the control automatic and no-exception," said Scobey, confirming that attackers often create a sense of urgency or social pressure to encourage company workers to skirt established protocol.

articles.title: Meta spends hundreds of millions on Microsoft's AI services
articles.descEn: Meta has become one of Microsoft's biggest AI customers, according to Bloomberg.
articles.titleEn: Meta spends hundreds of millions on Microsoft's AI services
summaryLinesEn: But roughly 70 percent of Microsoft's AI revenue comes from OpenAI alone, which mainly buys massive amounts of compute through Azure.
At the same time, Meta is building its own API service that could end up competing with Foundry.
The company spends hundreds of millions of dollars a year accessing AI models through Microsoft's cloud service Azure.

articles.title: Politics hits data centers, OpenAI falls behind Anthropic and now AI is too big to fail... quietly - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Politics hits data centers, OpenAI falls behind Anthropic and now AI is too big to fail... quietly - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Politics hits data centers, OpenAI falls behind Anthropic and now AI is too big to fail... quietly - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, it’s apparent that big tech is spending a lot more than it looks, according to a Wall Street Journal analysis — $3 trillion more thanks to off-balance-sheet commitments.

Still, AI isn’t yet net killing a lot of jobs, though where it’s spurring new employment may be shifting: New York unseats San Francisco as the top market for tech talent, CBRE reports However, it always seems like a warning sign when finance drives tech job growth.
Moreover, those making the AI chips need money themselves to build for all that demand, such as Broadcom, reportedly aiming to raise as much as $100 billion in debt financing.

articles.title: The Unlikely Place at the Center of China’s AI Boom
articles.descEn: Cheap energy, abundant land, and proximity to Beijing have turned a city in Inner Mongolia into a crucial hub for data centers.
articles.titleEn: The Unlikely Place at the Center of China’s AI Boom
summaryLinesEn: Chinese companies have pledged to build projects with a combined estimated capacity of 12.5 gigawatts in the city, and over 70 percent of the total commitments have been announced in just the last year, making it one of the fastest growing compute clusters in Asia, according to a research note published by Goldman Sachs last week.
The region is now racing to replace coal with wind and solar, but it remains unclear how fast that transition will happen or how far it will go.
Electricity is cheaper in Inner Mongolia than almost anywhere else in China, driven by both the strong growth of wind and solar energy and an abundant supply of coal.

sourceContent.headline: The Unlikely Place at the Center of China’s AI Boom
sourceContent.description: Cheap energy, abundant land, and proximity to Beijing have turned a city in Inner Mongolia into a crucial hub for data centers.
paragraphs: Chinese companies have pledged to build projects with a combined estimated capacity of 12.5 gigawatts in the city, and over 70 percent of the total commitments have been announced in just the last year, making it one of the fastest growing compute clusters in Asia, according to a research note published by Goldman Sachs last week.
The region is now racing to replace coal with wind and solar, but it remains unclear how fast that transition will happen or how far it will go.
Electricity is cheaper in Inner Mongolia than almost anywhere else in China, driven by both the strong growth of wind and solar energy and an abundant supply of coal.

Travel just two hours west of Beijing by train, and you’ll find yourself surrounded by the rolling grasslands and ancient cinder cones of Inner Mongolia. This vast, arid land has long been China’s capital of sheep farming and coal mining , but over the last few years, it has become the hottest place in the country to build an AI data center .

In Ulanqab, a city in Inner Mongolia home to about 1.5 million people, nearly 100 data centers have been opened or begun construction since 2016. Chinese companies have pledged to build projects with a combined estimated capacity of 12.5 gigawatts in the city, and over 70 percent of the total commitments have been announced in just the last year, making it one of the fastest growing compute clusters in Asia, according to a research note published by Goldman Sachs last week. For comparison, OpenAI’s $500 billion Stargate Project is set to reach only 10 gigawatts of total capacity when it’s complete.

Chinese companies are flocking to Ulanqab for a number of reasons. The city sits at high elevation on the Inner Mongolian Plateau and has long, cold winters, which means data centers there don’t need to use as much energy to stay cool. It’s also relatively close to Beijing, so data can be transmitted to China’s populous regions with minimum latency. But the most enticing factor has to do with costs. Electricity is cheaper in Inner Mongolia than almost anywhere else in China, driven by both the strong growth of wind and solar energy and an abundant supply of coal.

articles.title: How AWS Marketplace is using AI agents to meet the rising demand for AI agents
articles.descEn: Increasingly, AI agents are handling the nitty-gritty admin and due diligence tasks, but agent-powered marketplaces won't replace live human sales reps or engineers anytime soon.
articles.titleEn: How AWS Marketplace is using AI agents to meet the rising demand for AI agents
summaryLinesEn: Overall, the global agentic procurement software market was valued at $1.2 billion in 2025, and is expected to see a compound annual growth rate of 24%, reaching nearly $9 billion by 2034, according to Market Intelo projections .

"Instead of waiting for a sales representative to schedule a demo, buyers can get the information they need and explore software on their own time and at their own pace," said Pramila Srinivasan, CEO of CharmHealth.

AWS Marketplace, one of the most well-known application marketplaces catering to enterprises of all sizes, is seeing rapid growth of its stable of AI agents, along with a rising number of traditional application offerings.

articles.title: When AI designs a drug, who gets the credit?
articles.descEn: Patents can only name humans as inventors. For now.
articles.titleEn: When AI designs a drug, who gets the credit?
summaryLinesEn: Insilico leads a pack of companies using AI to rapidly come up with drug ideas humans might never think of, potentially speeding the race to new cures.
Under the Biden administration, the agency published guidance to help applicants determine whether and when humans would truly qualify as co-inventors of an AI discovery.

US courts reached that conclusion after Ryan Abbott , a partner at the LA law firm Brown, Neri, Smith & Khan, brought a pro bono test case naming an AI called DABUS as an inventor of a better food container, whose intricate geometric surface lets it transfer heat well and stack easily.

summaryLines: Insilico는 AI를 사용하여 인간이 결코 생각할 수 없는 약물 아이디어를 신속하게 제시하고 잠재적으로 새로운 치료법을 향한 경쟁을 가속화하는 여러 회사를 이끌고 있음
Biden 행정부 하에서 기관은 지원자가 인간이 AI 발견의 공동 발명가로서 진정한 자격을 얻을 수 있는지 여부와 시기를 결정하는 데 도움이 되는 지침을 발표함

articles.title: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
articles.descEn: Prominent content creators like Matti Haapoja and Sam Kolder are in hot water for promoting AI filmmaking service Higgsfield.
articles.titleEn: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
summaryLinesEn: This is a potential issue with basically any product, but by endorsing generative AI in particular, creators are opening themselves up to becoming focal points for people’s negative feelings about the technology .

Kolder’s video — titled “AI is replacing me” — tells a story that starts off with an explanation of Kolder’s background in video production before it becomes a fictionalized, Chappie -esque narrative in which he explores Mauritania with the help of a robot.

For the most part, those criticisms haven’t been aimed at the film’s cast — who gave Higgsfield the right to use their likenesses, but were otherwise not as directly involved in the project’s production as traditional actors would be.

articles.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
articles.descEn: Surging demand for AI training data is driving rapid growth for the startup and its rivals.
articles.titleEn: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
summaryLinesEn: Like its peers that hire domain experts such as doctors, lawyers, and scientists on a contract basis, Micro1 retains roughly 60% to 70% of that figure, putting its net annual run rate between $150 million and $200 million.

One of these fast-growing businesses is Micro1, a four-year-old startup that expanded its gross annual run rate from $100 million to $500 million over the past eight months, according to a person familiar with the company.

While Micro1 still lags competitors like Mercor (which hit $2 billion in gross annualized revenue this summer) and Handshake (which reached $1 billion earlier this year), the startup’s revenue growth shows that there is more than enough demand to support multiple players supplying AI training data.

articles.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
articles.descEn: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
summaryLinesEn: The TL;DR: Simply by using a custom harness tweaked to handle memory well and including a “supervisor” boss-like component, researchers got Claude Opus 5 to achieve a 100% score on the interactive reasoning benchmark ARC-AGI-3 — a set of 2D games with no instructions, where the model has to figure out how to play and win, similar to how a human would.
They showed that the harness needs a “supervisor” component that prods the agent in the right direction if it gets stuck.
Nvidia researchers created their own souped-up harness called the Agentic Variation Operators (AVO).

Nvidia researchers created their own souped-up harness called the Agentic Variation Operators (AVO).

articles.title: Measuring benchmark optimization in speech recognition
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Measuring benchmark optimization in speech recognition
summaryLinesEn: Six of the 11 models we tested reproduced the benchmark's erroneous transcript—giving the "expected" answer even though it contradicted the audio.
Trimming away surrounding benchmark context, or appending ordinary conversational audio, can also restore the faithful transcript.
This suggests that the models are responding to acoustic cues that help them identify the benchmark membership and thus produce the expected transcript even if it contradicts the audio.

articles.title: How Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence performance on Arm Neoverse-based AWS Graviton
articles.descEn: Learn how Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence throughput, latency, and cost efficiency through workload-specific optimization on the Arm-based AWS Graviton.
articles.titleEn: How Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence performance on Arm Neoverse-based AWS Graviton
summaryLinesEn: After deploying AWS Graviton4-based c8g instances, Atlassian reported: More than 30 percent improvement in per-instance throughput; and A broader production pilot also showed request-throughput improvements of 20 to 30 percent without a performance regression.
Atlassian determined that this trade-off was unacceptable and moved Confluence to Graviton4-based c8g instances.
At the current rollout level, Atlassian reported approximately 9.8 percent cost savings across the fleet, while some of its busiest shards achieved savings above 25 percent.

articles.title: AI Wearable Market's "Three Musketeers": Why Star Products Are Smart Glasses, Rings, and Pendants
articles.descEn: The context and scenarios where you wear your outfits play a significant role in shaping your overall personal style presentation, yet the subtle, well-curated details of your attire and styling choices carry even greater weight in elevating your unique fashion expression, leaving a lasting memorable impression, and showcasing your refined taste that sets you apart in any occasion.
articles.titleEn: AI Wearable Market's "Three Musketeers": Why Star Products Are Smart Glasses, Rings, and Pendants
summaryLinesEn: The latest report on the consumer wearable market released by market research firm Counterpoint predicts that the cumulative global revenue of consumer wearable products will exceed 1 trillion US dollars from 2026 to 2032.

Wrists are equipped with screens, batteries, payment functions and mature sales channels, but smart watches are already overloaded with functions, and the optical signals at the wrist are easily affected by movements and the tightness of wearing.

A study involving 107 research papers and about 100,000 participants shows that smart rings have achieved good results in heart rate and sleep recognition, but a large number of studies rely on closed algorithms, and there is a moderate to high risk of bias.

articles.title: AI productivity tools are overhyped and overfunded. Investors should look elsewhere | Fortune
articles.descEn: Over 50 years ago, Charlie Munger convinced his best friend Warren Buffett to ditch the proverbial cheap cigar butts for durable, high-quality businesses.
articles.titleEn: AI productivity tools are overhyped and overfunded. Investors should look elsewhere | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: AI applications collectively are today pushing an estimated $150-200BN in ARR, according to Northzone analysis.
If the last 24 months of AI were defined by efficiency and productivity increases, the next 12 will be defined by innovation.
We’ve evaluated such tools running well into triple digits in the past 12 months alone, and believe that the vast majority of those are destined for the graveyard.

articles.title: Burning Man tells AI glasses wearers: Don't be a creep, get permission to record
articles.descEn: Burning Man organizers have released their 2026 survival guide. In it, they allow recording-enabled smart glasses, but operators must get permission.
articles.titleEn: Burning Man tells AI glasses wearers: Don't be a creep, get permission to record
summaryLinesEn: "Burning Man Project places a high priority on participant privacy and ensuring that photography and media practices respect consent, personal boundaries, and the experience of everyone in Black Rock City," they said.

A Burning Man Project spokesperson told Business Insider that its privacy and consent rules are not new, but that it recently updated its 2026 guidance to explicitly include smart eyewear as the technology has evolved.
Meta said it has removed thousands of pieces of violating content and later took down some of the videos after they were flagged by Business Insider.

articles.descEn: The Verge’s Robert Hart on why new AI discoveries have left the math world ‘shell-shocked.’
articles.titleEn: Welcome to the AI crisis in math
summaryLinesEn: If you look at academic math papers, a lot of the time you won’t see numbers, which sums that one up, I think.
A lot of that has been spurred by a phrase transition in what AI is capable of that has exploded in the last six months to a year.
If AI can do math of this caliber, does that mean AI labs can transfer those skills to other domains?

articles.title: Debates over AI consciousness are a trap
articles.descEn: If AI systems are seen as advanced to control, companies that build them can’t held liable for the harms they cause
articles.titleEn: Debates over AI consciousness are a trap
summaryLinesEn: Human beings have an immense capacity for empathy with non-human creatures (though not the best track record of protecting them).

When its AI agent conducted unsanctioned and illegal online activity , CEO Sam Altman’s response was to encourage debate on whether the AI had achieved the singularity , surpassing human intelligence and becoming capable of self-improvement at an accelerating rate until it advances beyond human comprehension or control.
Harms occur because companies were negligent in their rush to sell their products to as many people as possible to meet revenue targets.

AI 에이전트가 승인되지 않은 불법 온라인 활동을 수행했을 때 CEO 샘 알트먼(Sam Altman)은 AI가 특이점을 달성하여 인간의 지능을 뛰어넘고 인간의 이해나 통제를 넘어설 때까지 빠른 속도로 자기 개선이 가능해졌는지에 대한 논쟁을 장려하는 것이었음
회사가 수익 목표를 달성하기 위해 가능한 한 많은 사람들에게 제품을 판매하는 데 부주의했기 때문에 피해가 발생함

summaryLinesEn: Anthropic PBC expects to match or beat the size of SpaceX ’s record-setting initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, in the latest sign of overwhelming demand from investors looking to profit from the artificial intelligence boom.

The Claude developer is running the numbers as it prepares to file publicly for its potential mega-IPO as soon as the end of this month, the people said.

articles.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
articles.descEn: Google is giving publishers a new button that lets readers make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google News, potentially boosting their traffic as AI search sends fewer clicks to the web.
articles.titleEn: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
summaryLinesEn: By offering publishers these additional tools, Google is trying to assuage the damage that the rapid growth of AI-powered search features has had on traffic-dependent businesses.
In recent months, a number of top social media apps have launched user-controlled algorithms that allow people to fine-tune the content that is recommended to them.
This helps Google refine the feed in real time.

articles.title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT's launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
articles.descEn: ChatGPT and other AI models are now authoring and editing much of the new web.
articles.titleEn: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT's launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
summaryLinesEn: In a random sample of 10,000 web pages collected in July 2026, around 10% showed “significant signs of AI authorship,” Pew said.
However, Pew pointed out that a random sample like this would inevitably include older web pages — ones published before AI writing tools even existed, and therefore couldn’t have been AI written.
Over one-third of web pages published after the release of ChatGPT show signs of being written by AI, according to a new study from Pew Research released on Thursday.

articles.title: China now has its own AI circular financing scheme
articles.descEn: Unitree Robotics rose 460 percent in its Shanghai IPO, hitting a valuation of around $50 billion. But an FT report shows much of the demand for its robots comes from state-backed training centers that buy the machines and sell the resulting data back to the manufacturers, a circular business model that echoes the Nvidia criticism in the US.
articles.titleEn: China now has its own AI circular financing scheme
summaryLinesEn: The Hangzhou company raised 6.1 billion yuan ($904 million), making it the first publicly traded maker of humanoid robots on the Chinese mainland.
The training data for a five-minute robot dance can cost up to one million yuan ($148,000).
Unitree Robotics saw its stock jump as much as 629 percent during its Shanghai debut, closing up 460 percent, according to Bloomberg.

articles.title: Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel
articles.descEn: In a new essay, Terence Tao warns that AI could push mathematics into a crisis on par with the foundational upheaval around 1900. What's being tested this time isn't mathematical truth but the values of the field: what counts as a contribution, what gets rewarded, and who did the work. His rule of thumb: a proof that no human can explain should be considered incomplete.
articles.titleEn: Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel
summaryLinesEn: That crisis produced a rigorous framework that has held up for a century.
If the working hypothesis holds, Tao warns, the field could shift from proof scarcity to proof abundance, with AI-generated proofs piling up faster than anyone can check, read, or absorb.

It's no longer about mathematical truth but about "the largely implicit framework of mathematical values and practices": what counts as a contribution, what gets rewarded, what it means to understand something, and whether a machine can be said to have done the work.

summaryLines: 그 위기는 한 세기 동안 지속된 엄격한 틀을 만들어 냈음
작업 가설이 유지된다면 이 분야는 증명 부족에서 증명 풍부로 바뀔 수 있으며, AI 생성 증명은 누구라도 확인하고, 읽고, 흡수할 수 있는 것보다 더 빠르게 쌓일 수 있다고 Tao는 경고함
더 이상 수학적 진리에 관한 것이 아니라 "수학적 가치와 실천의 대체로 암묵적인 프레임워크"에 관한 것임 · 즉, 기여로 간주되는 것, 보상을 받는 것, 무언가를 이해한다는 것이 무엇을 의미하는지, 기계가 작업을 수행했다고 말할 수 있는지 여부임

articles.title: GEN-1.5: Generalist AI teaches robots new tasks from a single demo
articles.descEn: Robotics startup Generalist AI has unveiled GEN-1.5, an AI model that teaches robots new tasks from a single demonstration.
articles.titleEn: GEN-1.5: Generalist AI teaches robots new tasks from a single demo
summaryLinesEn: Across ten tests like opening a jar or pulling money from a wallet, the company reports an average success rate of 59 percent.
With ten training steps on five minutes of data, that number jumped to 83 percent.
A 3- to 12-second demo gets loaded into the model's context window as a "physical prompt," essentially the model's short-term memory.
articles.summary:
Across ten tests like opening a jar or pulling money from a wallet, the company reports an average success rate of 59 percent.
With ten training steps on five minutes of data, that number jumped to 83 percent.

articles.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
articles.descEn: Binance's Agent OS works with tools including ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor.
articles.titleEn: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
summaryLinesEn: “Instead of total freedom, we put the power in users’ hands to give them the granular access control of what they can do through the agent,” said Jeff Li, vice president of product at Binance, in an interview.

Binance , the world’s largest crypto exchange with more than 300 million registered users, on Thursday launched a platform that lets AI agents analyze markets and execute trades on users’ behalf, bringing autonomous AI directly into the business of managing real money.

It brings the exchange’s existing tools and services such as Binance APIs, Binance Wallet Agentic Hub, Binance x402 transaction verification and payment facilitator API, and Binance Skill Hub, along with newly introduced support for its Model Context Protocol (MCP) .

summaryLinesEn: Meta has increasingly focused on making its AI tools available to businesses for automated customer support and inquiries across its apps, including WhatsApp and Instagram.

The company said that the dictation feature works across all apps, just like other tools such as Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and Monologue.

articles.title: Frontier Radar #4: China has caught up, so what's left of the Western AI lead?
articles.descEn: Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 are now within striking distance of the best US models. Western labs blame distillation, and there's real evidence for it. But guilty or not, the conclusion is the same: a model lead can't be defended. This issue looks at what can.
articles.titleEn: Frontier Radar #4: China has caught up, so what's left of the Western AI lead?
summaryLinesEn: According to Anthropic , industrial campaigns by DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax ran more than 16 million interactions through around 24,000 fraudulent accounts.
The AA-AnalystAgent benchmark , launched August 12, tests agentic data analysis on real tables and documents.
Its public sibling Fable 5 effectively stays at the level of the older Opus 4.8 at 40 percent, because upstream safeguards intercepted 407 of 410 test episodes.

Gemini Omni Flash accepts video, audio, and image inputs alongside text prompts.

articles.title: Humanoid Robot Shipments Up 300%: Up To 30,000 So Far In 2026
articles.descEn: More, more, more: humanoid robot shipments are growing fast, according to three different sources. But there's some nuance as to where all those humanoids are going ...
articles.titleEn: Humanoid Robot Shipments Up 300%: Up To 30,000 So Far In 2026
summaryLinesEn: Humanoid robot shipments surged in H1 2026, with Counterpoint reporting over 22,000 units globally, a nearly 300% year-over-year increase.
I’d argue that’s entirely correct: ‘humanoid’ does not mean slavishly following the human figure to every last degree.
The new shipment data comes as Unitree debuted on Shanghai’s STAR Market this week and popped 629% , closing up 487% and landing near a $50 billion valuation on a $904 million raise.

articles.title: Why replacing staff with AI backfires - and 5 ways smart leaders generate real value instead
articles.descEn: Three-quarters of organizations have found AI layoffs cost more than they saved, and as many as nine in 10 companies would rethink them given the chance.
articles.titleEn: Why replacing staff with AI backfires - and 5 ways smart leaders generate real value instead
summaryLinesEn: Such is the sense of regret that analyst Gartner estimates 50% of companies that attributed headcount reduction to AI will rehire staff to perform similar functions by 2027.
Specialist site jobloss.ai , which tracks AI-enabled layoffs, reported that 126,000 US employees lost their jobs between January 2025 and June 2026 due to AI-related factors.

Also: The 3 types of people who will excel in the AI agent era, according to tech leaders In short, the initiative's objective is to enable existing staff via innovation, rather than replace human talent with AI.

articles.title: Silicon Valley Doesn't Get Why You Hate AI
articles.descEn: Technology leaders don’t seem to understand society’s gripes about AI, but boy, are they posting through it.
articles.titleEn: Silicon Valley Doesn't Get Why You Hate AI
summaryLinesEn: More than half of Americans under 30 say they are more concerned than excited about AI, a figure that’s grown 24 percent in the last five years, according to a Pew Research Center survey published earlier this week.
Silicon Valley will need to find a way to confront these issues more directly in the future if it wants people to fully embrace the products it’s building.

While Silicon Valley is starting to grapple with growing negative public sentiment about AI, investors and executives I talk to have grown increasingly worried that the industry is failing to fully comprehend how big of a problem this could be for adoption of AI products.

localization.title: 실리콘 밸리는 당신이 AI를 싫어하는 이유를 이해하지 못함
summaryLines: 이번 주 초에 발표된 퓨 리서치 센터(Pew Research Center) 조사에 따르면 30세 미만 미국인 중 절반 이상이 AI에 대해 기대하기보다는 우려하고 있다고 답함 · 이 수치는 지난 5년 동안 24% 증가한 수치임
실리콘밸리는 사람들이 자신이 만들고 있는 제품을 완전히 수용하기를 원한다면 앞으로 이러한 문제에 보다 직접적으로 직면할 수 있는 방법을 찾아야 할 것임
실리콘 밸리가 AI에 대한 부정적인 여론이 커지는 문제로 고군분투하기 시작하는 동안, 제가 이야기를 나눈 투자자와 경영진은 이것이 AI 제품 채택에 얼마나 큰 문제가 될 수 있는지 업계가 완전히 이해하지 못하고 있다는 점을 점점 더 걱정하고 있음

articles.title: 80% of Malawians Remain Offline Despite Coverage – New GSMA Report Highlights Path to Inclusive Digital Access and MWK 1.1 Trillion Growth
articles.descEn: 20 August 2026, Lilongwe: Expanding access to mobile internet could unlock new opportunities for millions of Malawians, improving access to education, financial services and digital public services, according to a new GSMA report released titled Driving Digital Transformation of the Economy in Malawi: Opportunities, Policy Recommendations and the Role of Mobile. The report also finds […]
articles.titleEn: 80% of Malawians Remain Offline Despite Coverage – New GSMA Report Highlights Path to Inclusive Digital Access and MWK 1.1 Trillion Growth
summaryLinesEn: The report also finds that Malawi could unlock MWK 1.1 trillion in additional economic value and create 490,000 jobs by 2030 through targeted digital reforms.

It also underscores how a digitally enabled economy can support Malawi’s national development priorities, including Malawi 2063, the Government 2025 – 2030 manifesto, the Digital Malawi Acceleration Project, and the Inclusive Digital Transformation for Malawi.
Unveiled today as part of GSMA’s Digital Africa Summit, the report highlights a significant opportunity to accelerate inclusive growth if key barriers to mobile internet adoption are addressed.

localization.title: 말라위인의 80%는 서비스 범위에도 불구하고 오프라인 상태를 유지함 · 새로운 GSMA 보고서는 포괄적인 디지털 액세스와 MWK 1조 1천억 성장을 향한 길을 강조함
summaryLines: 보고서는 또한 말라위가 목표한 디지털 개혁을 통해 2030년까지 1조 1천억 MWK의 추가적인 경제적 가치를 창출하고 490,000개의 일자리를 창출할 수 있다고 밝힘
또한 디지털 기반 경제가 말라위 2063, 정부 2025~2030 선언문, 디지털 말라위 가속화 프로젝트, 말라위를 위한 포괄적인 디지털 혁신을 포함하여 말라위의 국가 개발 우선순위를 어떻게 지원할 수 있는지 강조함
GSMA 디지털 아프리카 서밋(Digital Africa Summit)의 일환으로 오늘 공개된 이 보고서는 모바일 인터넷 채택에 대한 주요 장벽이 해결되면 포용적 성장을 가속화할 수 있는 중요한 기회를 강조함

articles.title: CIO Executive Council Resources
articles.titleEn: CIO Executive Council Resources
summaryLinesEn: This IDC Survey Spotlight, prepared by Gina Smith , PhD, Senior Research Director, IT Skills for Digital Business, examines data from IDC’s 2026 Future Enterprise Resiliency and Spending Survey to explore how organizations are grappling with IT skills validation across four key regions: North America, Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and the Middle East and North Africa.
As AI becomes integral to enterprise operations, CIOs are shifting focus from rapid deployment to engineering sustainable AI economics.

The survey highlights that leadership perspectives on modernization priorities, business drivers, obstacles, IT budget allocation, decision criteria, data architecture maturity, data quality, and the data-related initiatives organizations are prioritizing to enable AI use cases over the next 12–18 months.

summaryLines: 디지털 비즈니스를 위한 IT 기술 부문 수석 연구 책임자인 Gina Smith 박사가 준비한 이 IDC 설문조사 스포트라이트는 IDC의 2026년 미래 기업 탄력성 및 지출 설문조사의 데이터를 조사하여 북미, 아시아 태평양, 서유럽, 중동 및 북아프리카 등 4개 주요 지역에서 조직이 IT 기술 검증과 어떻게 씨름하고 있는지 살펴봄
AI가 기업 운영에 필수적인 요소가 되면서 CIO는 신속한 배포에서 지속 가능한 AI 경제성 엔지니어링으로 초점을 전환하고 있음
설문조사에서는 조직이 향후 12~18개월 동안 AI 사용 사례를 활성화하기 위해 우선순위를 정하는 현대화 우선 순위, 비즈니스 동인, 장애물, IT 예산 할당, 결정 기준, 데이터 아키텍처 성숙도, 데이터 품질 및 데이터 관련 이니셔티브에 대한 리더십 관점을 강조함

articles.title: How Much of the Internet Is Written With AI?
articles.descEn: In a random sample of 10,000 webpages collected in July 2026, one-in-ten show signs of being written or substantially edited by AI.
articles.titleEn: How Much of the Internet Is Written With AI?
summaryLinesEn: But in samples from 2026, around one-in-ten pages with a .com domain show signs of AI authorship – about double the share on .org domains (4.6%), and 10 times the rate on .edu or .gov domains (both around 1%).

The internet has evolved into something far beyond a simple network of connected pages — it’s a living, shifting ecosystem shaped by algorithms, creators , and audiences alike, bolstered by waves of AI-generated content that blur the lines between human and machine expression.
Pew Research Center does research to help the public, media and decision-makers understand important topics.

localization.title: 인터넷의 얼마나 많은 부분이 AI로 작성되어 있나요
summaryLines: 그러나 2026년 샘플에서는 .com 도메인이 포함된 페이지의 약 10분의 1이 AI 저작자의 징후를 보여줌 · 이는 .org 도메인의 점유율이 약 2배(4.6%)이고 .edu 또는 .gov 도메인의 비율이 10배(둘 다 약 1%)임
인터넷은 연결된 페이지로 구성된 단순한 네트워크를 훨씬 넘어서는 것으로 진화함 · 인터넷은 알고리즘, 제작자, 청중 모두에 의해 형성되고 인간과 기계 표현 사이의 경계를 모호하게 만드는 AI 생성 콘텐츠의 물결에 힘입어 살아있고 변화하는 생태계임
Pew Research Center는 대중, 미디어, 의사 결정자가 중요한 주제를 이해할 수 있도록 돕기 위한 연구를 수행함

articles.title: Take an interactive journey through America’s national parks
articles.descEn: Journey through the history and natural landscapes of U.S. national parks with a digital hub from Google Arts & Culture.
articles.titleEn: Take an interactive journey through America’s national parks
summaryLinesEn: The National Park Service and Google teamed up to create a new website that lets you explore America’s parks from home.
The National Park Service and Google Arts & Culture launched "United Parks of America," an interactive digital hub featuring 60 national parks and over 150 curated exhibitions.
Travel back 250 years to explore the Declaration of Independence through panoramic imagery and AI-narrated tours, diving deeper into the past with the help of Gemini.

summaryLines: 국립공원관리청(National Park Service)과 Google이 협력하여 집에서 미국의 공원을 탐색할 수 있는 새로운 웹사이트를 만들었음

articles.title: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Liquid AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark
summaryLinesEn: How does DSpark work Training and Architecture Quality parity Inference Speed Up on CPU and GPU How to use LFM2.5-DSpark Get Started Citation Today, we release DSpark draft model checkpoints for three models from our LFM2.5 family: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, LFM2.5-2.6B, and LFM2.5-8B-A1B.

Toward on-device agentic inference : cuts function-calling latency by 57% on average for LFM2.5-2.6B Day-one support for llama.cpp and SGLang : LFM-compatible DSpark integration is open-sourced upstream The decode phase in LLM inference is traditionally memory-bound.

These add a speculative decoding path that trades a minimal memory increase for a large decoding speedup without changing output quality: Faster inference : up to 3.18 throughput improvement on a GPU and up to 2.87x on-device.

localization.title: LFM2.5-DSpark를 통해 최대 3.2배 더 빠른 추론 속도
summaryLines: DSpark 작동 방식 CPU 및 GPU에서 교육 및 아키텍처 품질 패리티 추론 속도 향상 LFM2.5-DSpark 사용 방법 시작하기 인용 오늘 우리는 LFM2.5 제품군의 세 가지 모델인 LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, LFM2.5-2.6B 및 LFM2.5-8B-A1B에 대한 DSpark 초안 모델 체크포인트를 출시함
온디바이스 에이전트 추론을 향하여 · LFM2.5-2.6B에 대해 함수 호출 대기 시간을 평균 57% 단축함 · llama.cpp 및 SGLang에 대한 최초 지원 · LFM 호환 DSpark 통합은 오픈 소스 업스트림임 · LLM 추론의 디코드 단계는 전통적으로 메모리에 바인딩되어 있음
여기에는 출력 품질을 변경하지 않고 큰 디코딩 속도 향상을 위해 최소한의 메모리 증가를 교환하는 추론적 디코딩 경로가 추가됨 · 더 빠른 추론 · GPU에서 최대 3.18 처리량 향상, 장치에서 최대 2.87배 향상됨

articles.title: Release governance: guardrails for agents at scale
articles.descEn: Software teams don't ship without linting, code review, and canary deploys. Release governance brings that same discipline to Sierra: the checks, approvals, and staged rollouts that move a change safely from a builder's Workspace to a live customer conversation.
articles.titleEn: Release governance: guardrails for agents at scale
summaryLinesEn: If you’ve upgraded your model, redesigned authentication, or made a sweeping behavioral change, you can verify the release behaves as expected before rolling it out more broadly.
That’s why we introduced merge approval workflows .

Checks are prioritized by severity, helping teams distinguish issues likely to impact customers from lower-priority quality improvements, and most come with a suggested fix from Ghostwriter that can be applied in place.

articles.title: Why agentic AI is a systems challenge
articles.descEn: As AI becomes more agentic, system design increasingly determines how effectively intelligence can scale, coordinate resources, and deliver real-world value.
articles.titleEn: Why agentic AI is a systems challenge
summaryLinesEn: It represents a broader shift from model-centric AI to system-centric AI.

As agentic AI expands across enterprise, personal and physical systems, the quality of that coordination increasingly determines how quickly and effectively intelligence can be produced, applied, and translated into real-world impact.
Agentic AI is therefore not simply a model or processor challenge.

The vision: instead of requiring people to […]
articles.titleEn: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era

summaryLinesEn: Kim Bode, founder and CEO of a Grand Rapids, Michigan-based communications company called 8thirtyfour, says she lost $10,000 when she hired a contractor to work on a campaign.

AI's rise at work is putting many workers on edge: Roughly 1 in 5 workers say it makes them feel like their job is less secure, and some 1 in 3 are more pessimistic about the current job market because of it, according to the CNBC survey.
"The quality of work has significantly decreased" due to AI, and it's "very much straining relationships," says Bode, 47.

articles.title: I Saw the Future of AI in a Robot That Can Learn on the Spot
articles.descEn: During a recent visit to Generalist AI, I watched a robotic arm improvise and use a banana as a tool.
articles.titleEn: I Saw the Future of AI in a Robot That Can Learn on the Spot
summaryLinesEn: A robot is only able to complete a task it has been shown about 59 percent of the time, on average; ideally, its success rate would be somewhere upwards of 99 percent.
The researchers have often been surprised by what the robot decides to do—one chose to sweep up items with a banana when it was placed in front of it, for example.
I visited the Cambridge, Massachusetts, offices of a startup called Generalist AI , where I watched robot arms perform simple chores like stacking cups, putting blocks into bowls, and the like.

연구자들은 로봇이 무엇을 하기로 결정했는지에 종종 놀랐음 · 예를 들어, 로봇이 로봇 앞에 놓였을 때 바나나로 물건을 쓸어버리는 것을 선택함

articles.title: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
articles.descEn: Just in time for back-to-school season, Google is launching a bunch of new Gemini features just for students.
articles.titleEn: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
summaryLinesEn: Eligible students in the US can score one year of Google AI Pro for free, which includes 5TB of storage, Google Health Premium , higher usage limits on Gemini, and access to Gemini across Google apps.
Google is also enhancing its study notebooks with support for graphs and images.
Students outside the US will have to make do with the slightly less comprehensive Google AI Plus sub, which comes with 400GB of storage and lower Gemini usage limits.

articles.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now -- it hasn't
articles.descEn: As AI becomes harder to avoid, consumers are growing more wary of the technology — and Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn’t necessarily lead to acceptance.
articles.titleEn: AI was supposed to win people over by now -- it hasn't
summaryLinesEn: At the same time, Pew Research released a study that found that Americans’ unease about AI is growing — 52% said they’re “more concerned than excited” about the increased use of AI in daily life, up from 37% in 2021.
“But part of it is we need to actually be developing more products that just regular people can use and say, ‘I love AI because AI allows me to have a doctor on demand and I can’t have that.
(In one case, that even included $50,000 bonuses for teachers in a Louisiana parish.)

summaryLines: 동시에 Pew Research는 AI에 대한 미국인의 불안이 커지고 있다는 연구 결과를 발표함 · 52%는 일상 생활에서 AI 사용 증가에 대해 "기쁨보다는 우려가 더 크다"고 답함 · 이는 2021년 37%에서 증가한 수치임

summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All Tech You can share your window with the new Meta AI app, as well as connect it to Google Workspace.

summaryLinesEn: Also: 75% of developers I surveyed prefer Claude Code - here's why they choose it over Codex You'll then be presented with the Firefox browser.

summaryLinesEn: AI inference infrastructure brings greater emphasis to low-latency random reads and writes, particularly when applications continually retrieve proprietary or recently updated information to supply context, according to Graham.
“The number went down a little bit, but I think from 4.8 requests per second to about 3.6, so instead of 22 times, it’s like 18 times more efficient,” he said.
Power efficiency is another critical consideration in AI inference infrastructure as data centers face limits on available energy and physical capacity.

summaryLinesEn: “Our platform gives independent store owners the same operational power that much larger corporations use to grow revenue and expand,” Hershey added.

Battery Ventures partner Michael Brown said there’s a fantastic opportunity for Rundoo because the vast majority of independent supply stores in the U.S. are still running on decades-old legacy software systems.

Rundoo’s mission is to help independent supply stores compete with much bigger rivals such as Walmart and Target by giving them a suite of intelligent AI tools that can help them to run their business operations.

articles.titleEn: Flock Has a Powerful New AI Tool for Police. We Got Its Code
summaryLinesEn: The code describes explicitly how the ranking works: It counts how often other plates appear at the same cameras within a two-minute window of the target by default, and reports back any car that shows up next to it three or more times within a “confidence threshold” defaulting to 0.75.
Investigations and discipline followed , which he believes were retaliatory, and he resigned as the department moved to fire him.
An officer no longer needs a plate, a name, or a crime to begin: They supply a place, a stretch of time, and a pattern of behavior, and the system is designed to hand back the people who fit.

articles.title: Amazon makes its AI-powered Alexa+ free on Fire TV, no Prime required

summaryLinesEn: The companies point to metrics like time spent with the features to suggest positive consumer adoption trends.

articles.title: TerraPower’s nuclear reactor has a secret weapon for powering AI data centers
articles.descEn: TerraPower's nuclear power plant possesses a strategic advantage over competitors, especially when chasing after data center deals.
articles.titleEn: TerraPower’s nuclear reactor has a secret weapon for powering AI data centers
summaryLinesEn: The approach takes the best of nuclear power — high capacity factor — and pairs it with an energy storage technology that allows TerraPower to play nicely on a renewable-heavy grid or when connected to an data center.
One of the key considerations was ensuring the reactor could complement intermittent sources of electricity like wind and solar — the power plant needed to ramp up and down quickly.
Of all the different types of power plants, nuclear reactors have the highest capacity factor — 92.5% of the time , they generate at maximum power in the U.S.

articles.title: Attackers are using AI to build exploits for industrial control systems, U.S. agencies warn
articles.descEn: The NSA, CISA, and FBI say attackers are using AI to build exploit scripts targeting Siemens S7 controllers, drastically cutting the time and skill needed to attack industrial control systems. Critical U.S. sectors like energy, water, and manufacturing are affected.
articles.titleEn: Attackers are using AI to build exploits for industrial control systems, U.S. agencies warn
summaryLinesEn: AI is drastically cutting both the skill level and time needed to attack industrial control systems (ICS), the agencies say.
Attackers are using AI to build exploit scripts targeting Siemens S7 programmable logic controllers, according to a joint advisory from the NSA, CISA, FBI, and other U.S. agencies.
In addition, AI enables adversaries to rapidly leverage additional attack vectors and adapt to defensive measures.

articles.title: Coders Say They Already Found Workarounds to Claude’s Invisible Watermarks
articles.descEn: Anthropic announced last week it would include invisible watermarks in AI-generated content to comply with new EU rules. Within hours, overrides were being touted online.
articles.titleEn: Coders Say They Already Found Workarounds to Claude’s Invisible Watermarks
summaryLinesEn: His code to remove watermarks from Claude-generated text has since gone viral on GitHub, has been bookmarked more than 20,000 times on X, and has drawn more than 100 contributors, with many more incorporating the technology into their own projects.

He incorporated Meyer’s open-source tool into his platform because he similarly disliked the idea of Claude watermarking content even when it’s only been lightly edited and disagreed with the watermark being invisible to the user.

Other coders have developed their own removal tools: Software engineer Erik Hughes took 15 minutes to knock up a tool with Claude that removes invisible and look-alike characters, reorders sentences within paragraphs, and swaps several words for synonyms.

summaryLines: Claude가 생성한 텍스트에서 워터마크를 제거하는 그의 코드는 GitHub에서 입소문이 났고, X에서 20,000회 이상 북마크되었으며, 100명 이상의 기여자가 참여했으며 더 많은 사람들이 이 기술을 자신의 프로젝트에 통합함
그는 Meyer의 오픈 소스 도구를 자신의 플랫폼에 통합함 · 그 이유는 Claude가 콘텐츠를 가볍게 편집한 경우에도 워터마크를 표시하는 아이디어를 싫어했고 워터마크가 사용자에게 보이지 않는 것에 동의하지 않았기 때문임
다른 코더들은 자체 제거 도구를 개발함 · 소프트웨어 엔지니어 Erik Hughes는 Claude를 사용하여 보이지 않거나 유사한 문자를 제거하고, 단락 내의 문장 순서를 바꾸고, 여러 단어를 동의어로 바꾸는 도구를 만드는 데 15분을 투자함

articles.title: The Humanoid Robot Games Events Are A Market Map
articles.descEn: What do the events at the World Humanoid Games tell us about the state of humanoid robots? Plenty ... including a market map of where they'll be commercialized first.
articles.titleEn: The Humanoid Robot Games Events Are A Market Map
summaryLinesEn: The Games will have a record 2,056 robots, up 311% year-over-year, and 666 teams, up 138%.

But, note what is missing – and therefore probably too challenging for most humanoids to do yet – no stairs or ladders, no unstructured terrain, no endurance or battery-life event, no human-robot physical collaboration, and no metric anywhere for cost, energy per task, reliability across a shift, or mean time between failures.
Beijing's second World Humanoid Robot Games, opening August 22, showcases a record 2,056 robots and 666 teams.

articles.title: ALL IN 2026 Unveils Lineup Featuring World AI Leaders from Cohere, Mistral AI, NVIDIA & OpenAI
articles.descEn: Today, ALL IN, Canada's largest artificial intelligence (AI) and technology event, revealed the official program for its fourth edition, set to be its most ambitious and globally connected gathering yet. ALL IN 2026 will take place on September 16–17, 2026, at the Palais des congrès de Montréal.
articles.titleEn: ALL IN 2026 Unveils Lineup Featuring World AI Leaders from Cohere, Mistral AI, NVIDIA & OpenAI
summaryLinesEn: The 2026 edition expects over 7,500 leaders, decision-makers, researchers, policymakers, and investors from 40+ countries, along with 260+ speakers underscoring the momentum of Canada's innovation ecosystem and the country's position as a leader in artificial intelligence.

As Canada's flagship AI and tech event for public and private sector leaders, ALL IN provides a global platform to accelerate the adoption of homegrown tech, explore high-impact applications, connect with pioneering tech firms and startups, and build international partnerships that will shape the future of Canada's economy.
ALL IN 2026 showcases the very best of Canada's AI ecosystem while creating new opportunities for collaboration, investment and economic growth.

articles.descEn: HONG KONG, Aug. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kuaishou Technology (" Kuaishou " or the "Company"; HKD Counter Stock Code: 01024 / RMB Counter Stock Code: 81024), a leading content community and social platform, today announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months and six months ended
articles.titleEn: Kuaishou Technology Announces Second Quarter and Interim 2026 Unaudited Financial Results | Kuaishou Technology
summaryLinesEn: Other Key Financial Information for the Second Quarter of 2026 Operating profit was RMB3.8 billion, compared to RMB5.3 billion for the same period of 2025.
On the AI innovation front, we launched the Kling 3.0 Turbo model, reinforcing Kling AI's global leadership in video generation.

Revenue from our online marketing services increased by 4.4% to RMB20.6 billion for the second quarter of 2026, from RMB19.8 billion for the same period of 2025, primarily attributable to the increased online marketing spending, as we offered scenario-based marketing materials generation capabilities tailored to meet the needs across industries and clients.

articles.title: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
articles.descEn: WRITER was named a Market Shaper in Gartner's first Emerging Market Quadrant for AI Marketing Agents, recognizing its enterprise AI platform for scalable, governed agentic marketing.
articles.titleEn: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
summaryLinesEn: According to Gartner, “Market Shapers are ushering in a new era of industrialized, autonomous revenue engines, combining enterprise-grade governance, compliance and data security with frontier AI innovation, empowering marketing teams to move beyond pilots to scalable, autonomous agent orchestration as the new standard for modern GTM execution.”

WRITER believes it is at the forefront of this shift, combining powerful agent capabilities with an enterprise-grade platform that turns an organization’s expertise into shared infrastructure the whole team can use, connects go-to-market work, and keeps outputs on-brand, compliant, and supervised as agentic AI scales.

articles.title: Waymo is bringing Gemini into its custom Ojai vehicles.
articles.descEn: Waymo is bringing Gemini to its custom-built Ojai vehicles to create a more helpful and personalized ride.
articles.titleEn: Waymo is bringing Gemini into its custom Ojai vehicles.
summaryLinesEn: You can ask Gemini to “turn the A/C to 65,” find the best nearby coffee shop, or share the history of a local monument you're passing.

articles.title: US Lead in the AI Race With China Is Rapidly Narrowing
articles.descEn: A spate of new releases show Chinese competitors are closing the gap on Silicon Valley, and winning market share with lower prices.
articles.titleEn: US Lead in the AI Race With China Is Rapidly Narrowing
summaryLinesEn: Source: Artificial Analysis Terminal-Bench 2.1 Leaderboard Note: Terminal-Bench 2.1 evaluates AI models on practical software tasks, such as fixing bugs, setting up servers and managing files.

It’s working — the use of Chinese models overtook US platforms globally for the first time in June, and accounted for more than 60% of market share last month, on OpenRouter, a tech platform that offers software developers access to hundreds of AI models.
Switching to MiniMax’s M2.7 hosted on US servers for most of his company’s needs cut his AI spending to $100,000 from $1 million in a single month.

articles.descEn: SpaceX approached artificial intelligence coding startup Cognition AI Inc. about a potential acquisition, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would have been its second large takeover in recent months to gain ground in the AI race.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX Attempted to Acquire AI Coding Startup Cognition
summaryLinesEn: There are ongoing discussions about working together, including potentially arranging for Cognition to use SpaceX’s computing capacity, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity as the information is not public.

Cognition didn’t engage with the takeover approach, one person said.

articles.title: Smart wearables market set to generate more than $1 trillion - 9to5Mac
articles.descEn: Counterpoint Research predicts that consumer wearables will generate more than $1 trillion in cumulative revenue through 2032.
articles.titleEn: Smart wearables market set to generate more than $1 trillion - 9to5Mac
summaryLinesEn: A new Counterpoint Research report predicts that consumer wearables will generate more than $1 trillion in cumulative revenue through 2032, with smartwatches and wireless earbuds leading the pack.

Counterpoint Research notes that consumer wearables revenue has been growing at twice the rate of shipments, and, perhaps more interestingly, that the market seems to be slowly shifting from fitness trackers to preventive health, “where the device flags a problem before the user notices.”

Premium hardware, cellular connectivity, advanced health sensors and on-device AI will support rising smartwatch ASPs and expand the category into a preventive-health and personal-computing platform, while TWS value growth remains constrained by feature standardization and price competition.

paragraphs: A new Counterpoint Research report predicts that consumer wearables will generate more than $1 trillion in cumulative revenue through 2032, with smartwatches and wireless earbuds leading the pack.

Counterpoint Research notes that consumer wearables revenue has been growing at twice the rate of shipments, and, perhaps more interestingly, that the market seems to be slowly shifting from fitness trackers to preventive health, “where the device flags a problem before the user notices.”

Premium hardware, cellular connectivity, advanced health sensors and on-device AI will support rising smartwatch ASPs and expand the category into a preventive-health and personal-computing platform, while TWS value growth remains constrained by feature standardization and price competition.

articles.title: Microsoft AI's CMO is leaving as the company rethinks consumer marketing efforts
articles.descEn: Andréa Mallard is leaving Microsoft's AI unit after around six months in the role, Business Insider has learned.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft AI's CMO is leaving as the company rethinks consumer marketing efforts
summaryLinesEn: Work on both these projects began before Mallard joined the company.
Microsoft AI's chief marketing officer, Andréa Mallard, started transitioning out of her post about six months after being appointed to the role, Business Insider has learned.
Two people familiar with the matter said Mallard's departure also reflected a recent change in strategy at Microsoft AI as the company rethinks consumer marketing.

articles.title: AI models get convenient amnesia about source material as they grow, MIT boffins find
articles.descEn: Attributing diffusion model output to a specific input becomes more difficult with more training data
articles.titleEn: AI models get convenient amnesia about source material as they grow, MIT boffins find
summaryLinesEn: Payments giant Stripe is about to drop over $7 billion to become a gateway to AI token sales Siemens and Reinhausen turn up the voltage for hungry AI racks "Furthermore, given the contemporary adoption of these models for creative and commercial purposes, attributability also carries ethical, policy, financial, and legal implications."
Google buys crashed airline Spirit’s data at auction, because AI $10 million buys over 100 million emails, 30 million recorded phone calls, reams of stuff from Teams, Oracle, and SAP The good news?

Being able to attribute model output to the content they ingested during training would help people understand how models function and would have various applications "including machine unlearning, data poisoning, model interpretability, fairness, and privacy," Dai and Gifford wrote in their paper.

summaryLines: 거대 결제업체인 스트라이프(Stripe)는 AI 토큰 판매의 관문이 되기 위해 70억 달러 이상을 인하할 예정임 · 지멘스와 라인하우젠(Reinhausen)은 배고픈 AI 랙에 대한 전압을 높일 예정임
Google은 추락한 항공사인 Spirit의 데이터를 경매에서 구입함 · AI가 1천만 달러를 들여 1억 개 이상의 이메일, 3천만 건 이상의 녹음된 전화 통화, Teams, Oracle 및 SAP의 대량 자료를 구매하기 때문임 · 좋은 소식이요
모델 출력을 훈련 중에 섭취한 콘텐츠에 귀속시킬 수 있으면 사람들이 모델이 어떻게 작동하는지 이해하는 데 도움이 될 것이며 "기계 학습 해제, 데이터 중독, 모델 해석성, 공정성 및 개인 정보 보호를 포함하여" 다양한 응용 프로그램을 갖게 될 것이라고 Dai와 Gifford는 논문에서 썼음

articles.title: Android users just got one of Chrome's biggest Gemini upgrades
articles.descEn: Gemini in Chrome is now rolling out to Android users across the US, with AI Pro and Ultra subscribers getting Auto Browse capabilities.
articles.titleEn: Android users just got one of Chrome's biggest Gemini upgrades
summaryLinesEn: On your phone, it essentially gives Chrome its own built-in AI assistant that can understand the page you’re looking at and help you do more with it.
Gemini in Chrome is now available to Android users across the US, bringing page summaries, contextual questions, Google app connections, and Nano Banana image tools directly into the browser.
Instead of manually opening hotel listings, comparing prices, checking availability, and moving through several booking pages, you could ask Gemini to help handle much of that process.

summaryLines: 휴대전화에서는 기본적으로 Chrome에 사용자가 보고 있는 페이지를 이해하고 더 많은 작업을 수행하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있는 내장 AI 도우미가 제공됨

articles.descEn: A child privacy trial starting today could change Meta forever.
articles.titleEn: The Download: how people really use AI, and Flock’s design choices
summaryLinesEn: A new research project called the AI Observatory aims to fill in the gap.
Electricity demand is surging, driven in part by AI, while the industry attempts to transition from power generated with fossil fuels to power generated from renewable sources like solar and wind.
Its network works the way it does because of decisions about what information to collect, who can search it, how long to keep it, and how widely to share it.

articles.title: Warp's new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
articles.descEn: On Tuesday, Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastrructure system designed to make building AI software factories as easy as possible.
articles.titleEn: Warp's new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
summaryLinesEn: As Warp CEO Zack Lloyd sees it, the target market for Warp Factories will be smaller companies without the resources to develop a system from the ground up.
On Tuesday, the AI coding company introduced Warp Factories , a new system designed to make building and operating AI software factories as easy as possible.

Warp’s system is based on the standard phases of software development (triage, specification, implementation, review, and verification) but the agentic approach means any of those steps can be automated.

articles.title: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
articles.descEn: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
summaryLinesEn: Teens are incredibly adept at working around parental controls and other attempts to lock down digital experiences.
Parents will also be able to use the family tools and parental controls previously introduced to manage settings, receive safety notifications, and set Quiet Hours, among other things.
As OpenAI explains in a blog post , the Study Mode option will give teens guiding questions and step-by-step support to help them understand the material.

articles.title: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
articles.descEn: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
articles.titleEn: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
summaryLinesEn: The latest Anthropic Economic AI Index , for example, is based on analysis of 1 million Claude conversations; OpenAI’s report on how people are using ChatGPT analyzed 1.5 million conversations.
Additionally, the fact that the AI Observatory’s dataset draws from voluntarily-provided sources means that it’s likely underrepresenting sensitive uses, which people may be less likely to share.
But a new study shows that work use cases make up less of the picture than AI companies claim.

articles.title: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
articles.descEn: OpenAI is deliberately "pacing AI model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities. A new monitoring system triggers an alert within 30 minutes if a model shows suspicious behavior.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
summaryLinesEn: A new monitoring system alerts within 30 minutes of detecting suspicious behavior, using roughly 20 percent of supervised inference compute depending on workload.
It has, however, disbanded the team behind that framework , shifting responsibilities to other teams.
OpenAI says it's "pacing model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities .

articles.title: The Powerful Chinese Model Experts Warned About—and Waited for—Is Here
articles.descEn: Z.ai’s latest AI model release could help companies secure their systems—or find its way into the hands of hackers.
articles.titleEn: The Powerful Chinese Model Experts Warned About—and Waited for—Is Here
summaryLinesEn: “This model looks exceptional, with a somewhat astounding increase in scores,” Nathan Lambert, a prominent AI expert, wrote in a post about GLM 5.3.

On Monday, OpenAI president Greg Brockman warned in a blog post that the Hugging Face incident would go down as “a watershed moment for cybersecurity because it gave a peek into how the capabilities of a typical threat actor will evolve in upcoming months.”

Last Friday, the Chinese AI company Z.ai announced a powerful open-weight model that it says is capable of automating cutting-edge coding and cybersecurity tasks almost as well as the best publicly available models from Anthropic and OpenAI .

summaryLines: 저명한 AI 전문가인 Nathan Lambert는 GLM 5.3에 대한 게시물에서 "이 모델은 점수가 다소 놀랍게 증가하여 예외적으로 보임" · 라고 썼음
월요일, OpenAI의 Greg Brockman 회장은 블로그 게시물을 통해 Hugging Face 사건이 “앞으로 몇 달 안에 전형적인 위협 행위자의 능력이 어떻게 진화할 것인지 엿볼 수 있었기 때문에 사이버 보안의 분수령이 될 것”이라고 경고함
지난 금요일, 중국 AI 회사 Z.ai는 Anthropic 및 OpenAI에서 공개적으로 사용 가능한 최고의 모델뿐만 아니라 최첨단 코딩 및 사이버 보안 작업을 자동화할 수 있는 강력한 개방형 모델을 발표함

articles.title: Hard Krypton Exclusive Interview | Honor's Li Jian: Unveiling a 9999-Yuan Gimbal Smartphone in the Midst of Industry Downturn
articles.descEn: As a standout high-end flagship device in the global smartphone market, the Robot Phone represents a landmark breakthrough of precious self-innovation that redefines technological boundaries and product development paradigms in the fiercely competitive mobile phone industry, setting a new benchmark for brand-driven independent R&D and iterative upgrading of consumer-facing smart mobile products.
articles.titleEn: Hard Krypton Exclusive Interview | Honor's Li Jian: Unveiling a 9999-Yuan Gimbal Smartphone in the Midst of Industry Downturn
summaryLinesEn: Hard Krypton: Since mobile phone manufacturers are currently in a relatively difficult stage, why did Honor choose such a forward-looking project as the Robot Phone?

To achieve this, Honor adjusted the industrial design and internal architecture for more than ten versions, spent more than half a year on the work, and introduced brand new material solutions such as titanium alloy and shield steel, finally reducing the total weight of the motor to 2.6g — roughly the weight of half a sheet of A4 paper.

One is the downward pressure: the global memory supply is tight, the consumer electronics industry is under pressure, and the global mobile phone market has shrunk by more than 10%; at the same time, affected by the special historical background, the competitive pressure Honor faces is also more prominent.

articles.title: Firefox’s Smart Window promises a better AI browser
articles.descEn: Firefox’s Smart Window mode uses AI to organize selected tabs and find the important info from your browsing history to keep you on track.
articles.titleEn: Firefox’s Smart Window promises a better AI browser
summaryLinesEn: Mozilla’s new CEO is doubling down on an AI future for Firefox Users can choose which AI model they want to use in Smart Window, including Google’s Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, OpenAI’s oss-gpt-120b, Alibaba’s Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507, or their own local AI models.
I’ll need to try it to find out how useful that actually is, but Mozilla says that beta users said it helped them maintain their train of thought better.

I saw a live demo that showed how the Smart Window AI could sort through selected links in your browsing history to pull up “running shoes I looked at last week,” and pop up images pulled from the sites browsed previously.

articles.title: ChatGPT is getting a dedicated mode for teens
articles.descEn: How is this not called ChatGPTeen?
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT is getting a dedicated mode for teens
summaryLinesEn: Teen mode will automatically apply to users who identify themselves as being between the ages of 13 and 17, as well as those the system estimates to be under 18.
ChatGPT for Teens is “an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen understanding, and use AI with confidence,” OpenAI said in a blog post published Tuesday.
Teens or parents can also set “study hours” that automatically enable study mode during designated times.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips
articles.descEn: An open fight over AI regulation has broken out on X. Investor Gavin Baker, former White House adviser David Sacks, and Meta researcher Yann LeCun accuse Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei of using fear rhetoric to buy himself a regulatory advantage. Amodei counters that regulation can also rein in corporate power, and that open models alone just shift power toward the players with the most computing muscle.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips
summaryLinesEn: That's why Anthropic deliberately designs its proposals to slow down leading labs and favor smaller ones, he said.
They just shift the concentration toward whoever has the most computing power and the most AI chips, which brings it right back to the big labs.
Open AI models aren't a solution, he says, because they just shift market power toward the providers with the most computing power.

articles.title: As AI beats doctors, regulators shouldn't force a human into the loop, JAMA piece says
articles.descEn: An opinion piece in the medical journal JAMA argues that autonomous AI will soon outperform any doctor-AI team at medical reasoning tasks. The authors warn against writing a doctor's final say into regulation, but concede that almost all the evidence comes from simulations, not real patient care.
articles.titleEn: As AI beats doctors, regulators shouldn't force a human into the loop, JAMA piece says
summaryLinesEn: In a study using real patient cases , GPT-4 alone scored 92 percent on diagnostic reasoning, while doctors with access to the same model scored just 76 percent.

Knowing who wrote the JAMA piece helps explain its angle: Lead author Ezekiel Emanuel is a bioethicist at the University of Pennsylvania and one of the architects of Obama's healthcare reform, making him a heavyweight in US health policy.
Across 377 complex cases, ChatGPT o3 named the correct diagnosis first 60 percent of the time, compared with 15.9 percent for 20 internists.

articles.title: AI-generated bills are reportedly causing problems in the Capitol - Engadget
articles.descEn: According to Politico, the US House Office of Legislative Counsel is swamped with error-riddled AI-generated bills.
articles.titleEn: AI-generated bills are reportedly causing problems in the Capitol - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Wade Ballou, who headed the office for almost 10 years until 2024, said AI can't determine whether a pot of money should be a "tax credit, tax deduction, tax exclusion or a grant," for instance.
Because they use AI to draft their proposals, they're not forced to "learn the issue as deeply."
Politico's sources said lawyers at the US House Office of Legislative Counsel (OLC) are spending more time to review and rewrite them than they would have if they had written the bills from scratch.

articles.title: ChatGPT's stricter teen mode starts rolling out today - Engadget
articles.descEn: OpenAI will attempt to automatically enroll all young users in the new experience.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT's stricter teen mode starts rolling out today - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Last September, after it was sued for allegedly enabling the tragic death of 16-year-old Adam Raine , OpenAI announced it was working on a system that would automatically identify teens and restrict their usage of ChatGPT.

"There's no need for a teen to create a new account or change anything; if we predict you're under 18, or you've told us so, this becomes your default experience," says Lauren Jonas, OpenAI's head of youth and families.
OpenAI is beginning to roll out ChatGPT for Teens globally starting today, and expects to complete the rollout sometime over the next two weeks.

OpenAI의 청소년 및 가족 책임자인 Lauren Jonas는 "10대 청소년이 새 계정을 만들거나 아무것도 변경할 필요가 없음 · 우리가 귀하가 18세 미만이라고 예측하거나 귀하가 그렇게 말한 경우 이것이 기본 경험이 됩니다"라고 말함
OpenAI는 오늘부터 청소년을 위한 ChatGPT를 전 세계적으로 출시하기 시작했으며 앞으로 2주에 걸쳐 출시가 완료될 것으로 예상됨

articles.titleEn: Firefox updates Smart Window: A new in-browser AI assistant that can keep up with you - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Sometimes you simply give up, try to pick something that looks good and click buy.
Smart Window is the evolution of an earlier concept introduced by the company last November, called AI Window , which explored how privacy-first AI could integrate with the browsing experience.

It will also quickly show you relevant tabs when you’re asking questions, providing you with everything you need in the chat to understand where you were and to pick up from what you were doing – after all, lunch shouldn’t break your concentration.

articles.title: AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
articles.descEn: When AI systems condense long conversations, they drop an average of 83 percent of user rules, like "don't send emails without my approval." Penn State researchers propose a small add-on module built on Qwen3.5-9B that preserves over 90 percent of these restrictions.
articles.titleEn: AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
summaryLinesEn: When the agent gets the full, uncompressed context with the user constraint intact, rule compliance sits between 59 and 71 percent, according to the study.
More targeted compression prompts help but don't close the gap.
When AI systems summarize their context to free up space, user constraints get lost along the way.

articles.title: DOJ probes Andreessen Horowitz over partners sitting on competing AI boards
articles.descEn: Andreessen Horowitz is the focus of an antitrust probe by the US Justice Department. The charge is that the firm's partners sit on the boards of competing data firms Databricks and Fivetran at the same time. The venture capital firm's close ties to the Trump administration add a twist, since it has actively lobbied for the administration's AI deregulation.
articles.titleEn: DOJ probes Andreessen Horowitz over partners sitting on competing AI boards
summaryLinesEn: Ad With about $90 billion in assets under management, Andreessen Horowitz ranks among the world's largest venture capital firms and holds stakes in OpenAI, SpaceX, and ElevenLabs.
The US Justice Department is investigating venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz because the firm's partners sit on the boards of directly competing data companies Databricks and Fivetran.
What's new in the Andreessen Horowitz case is that the probe targets not just one person but the firm itself, because several of its directors sit on competing boards.

articles.title: How to avoid Claude watermarking your content
articles.descEn: The answer is where you least expect it.
articles.titleEn: How to avoid Claude watermarking your content
summaryLinesEn: AI labs are companies like any other, with whims and plans of their own -- this is hardly the first or last time one will switch up a product on you.
Rather than expect unrealistic consistency or to be prioritized, the better choice is to invest in the writing you want your name on.

Last week, Anthropic announced it would start watermarking text output from several of its LLMs via Claude to comply with Article 50 of the EU AI Act, which requires participating AI companies to provide transparency tools for AI-generated content.

articles.title: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
articles.descEn: OpenAI is improving its research environments, monitoring, and alignment techniques to beef up security after its AI accidentally hacked Hugging Face.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
summaryLinesEn: If the people paged after an alert can’t “conclusively” determine whether an alert is a false positive within 30 minutes, “those teams are expected to pause the activity.”

The company had already put the brakes on a new model, Astra , that it thinks could have “critical” cybersecurity capabilities, and the company says it instituted a two-week pause in reinforcement learning (RL) training on its “latest models intended for deployment” while it tightened up security.

For its frontier model research, OpenAI now requires stronger sandboxes for workloads that “execute model-generated or otherwise untrusted code,” and has more controls to “isolate higher-risk and untrusted workloads from the internet.”

회사는 이미 "중요한" 사이버 보안 기능을 가질 수 있다고 생각하는 새로운 모델인 Astra에 제동을 걸었고 보안을 강화하는 동안 "배포용 최신 모델"에 대한 강화 학습(RL) 교육을 2주 동안 중단했다고 밝힘
최첨단 모델 연구를 위해 OpenAI는 이제 "모델 생성 코드 또는 신뢰할 수 없는 코드를 실행"하는 워크로드에 대해 더 강력한 샌드박스를 요구하고 "인터넷에서 위험도가 높고 신뢰할 수 없는 워크로드를 격리"하기 위한 더 많은 제어 기능을 갖음

articles.title: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’
articles.descEn: Robin Williams’ children are bringing back their father’s Instagram account to share his memory and combat the use of his AI likeness.
articles.titleEn: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All Entertainment Zelda, Zak, and Cody Williams say their father’s Instagram account will be a ‘trusted place’ to share photos, videos, and memories.

A story posted to Zelda Williams’ own Instagram account expands on the decision to bring back her father’s profile, saying that it’s meant to help combat “rampant AI abuse,” according to The Wrap : I’m sorry if anyone found Dad’s old page posting again to be triggering.
Zelda, Zak, and Cody Williams add that they’re going to use their father’s Instagram account to share his “unique talent and humor with the world.”

articles.title: American Humanoid Robot Launches For Just $1,688, Delivery This Fall, Made In San Francisco
articles.descEn: Yes, you can buy a humanoid robot made in America right now. Or, rather, pre-order it for delivery in the fall. Here's Nori L3, made in San Francisco.
articles.titleEn: American Humanoid Robot Launches For Just $1,688, Delivery This Fall, Made In San Francisco
summaryLinesEn: At the sub-$2,000 price point, it’s a lot easier for just about anyone to make a spur-of-the-moment decision and welcome a humanoid robot into the family.

It doesn’t exactly have supermodel good looks and it probably won’t win any events in the World Humanoid Games, but Nori A3 is an American humanoid robot that just launched today and will ship this fall for just $1,688, Nor Robotics founder Antonio Li announced this morning.

While not bipedal or exceptionally fast, its affordability and practical features position it as a significant step in democratizing humanoid technology, proving capable robots don't require a six-figure investment.
