articles.title: Xiaomi ‘in no rush’ to turn vast AI spending into profits despite earnings slump
articles.descEn: The Chinese tech firm has seen its net profits decline for three consecutive quarters, as it rapidly ramps up AI-related R&D spending.
articles.titleEn: Xiaomi ‘in no rush’ to turn vast AI spending into profits despite earnings slump
summaryLinesEn: In the first half of the year, Xiaomi’s spending on research and development jumped 25.6 per cent year on year to 18.2 billion yuan (US$2.7 billion), with AI-related inputs accounting for nearly 30 per cent of the total, Lam said on Tuesday.

The Chinese tech firm has seen its net profits decline for three consecutive quarters, as it rapidly ramps up AI-related R&D spending Chinese technology giant Xiaomi has said it is “in no rush” to convert its large investments in artificial intelligence into profit, after recording another decline in net profits in the second quarter amid intense competition and cost inflation.

However, as a large corporation, Xiaomi is in no rush to pursue immediate monetisation,” said Alain Lam, the firm’s vice-president and chief financial officer, during an earnings call on Tuesday evening.

articles.title: Multi-Vector (Late Interaction) Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Multi-Vector (Late Interaction) Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
summaryLinesEn: What late interaction adds is that it does so without giving up the other direction: when an exact match is what matters (a product code, a surname, a function name), MaxSim still has that token sitting there on its own, where a single-vector model had to average it in with everything else.

PyLate comes up throughout this post, so briefly: Sentence Transformers handled dense and sparse models but not late interaction, so LightOn built PyLate on top of it to close that gap, adding the training, inference, and retrieval pieces these models need.

For ColPali-style visual document retrieval, you also need the image dependencies (see Installation for all extras, and Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models for multimodal support in general): Sentence Transformers v6.0 requires transformers v5.x, torch 2.2+, and huggingface-hub v1.x.

articles.title: The $Trillion Bottleneck: Intel Bets EMIB, ZAM and XBM Against TSMC’s CoWoS
articles.descEn: AI accelerator shipments will drive advanced packaging demand at scale: over 130 million GPUs/AI ASICs are expected to ship with advanced-packaged on-compute memory over the next five years,…
articles.titleEn: The $Trillion Bottleneck: Intel Bets EMIB, ZAM and XBM Against TSMC’s CoWoS
summaryLinesEn: AI accelerator shipments will drive advanced packaging demand at scale: over 130 million GPUs/AI ASICs are expected to ship with advanced-packaged on-compute memory over the next five years , generating almost $2 Trillion in compute revenue .
HBM's reliance on TSMC's CoWoS silicon interposers carries steep costs with thick packages, yield risk, capacity constraints and high scrap costs, thus, creating an opening for credible alternatives.
TSMC still leads on high-volume manufacturing, maturity and JEDEC- standard ecosystem lock-in , catching up on like-by-like innovation for CoWoS.

localization.title: 1조 달러 규모의 병목 현상 · Intel은 TSMC의 CoWoS에 맞서 EMIB, ZAM 및 XBM을 베팅함
summaryLines: AI 가속기 출하로 고급 패키징 수요가 대규모로 늘어날 것임 · 향후 5년 동안 1억 3천만 개가 넘는 GPU/AI ASIC이 고급 패키지 온컴퓨팅 메모리와 함께 출하되어 거의 2조 달러에 달하는 컴퓨팅 수익을 창출할 것으로 예상됨
TSMC의 CoWoS 실리콘 인터포저에 대한 HBM의 의존은 두꺼운 패키지, 수율 위험, 용량 제약 및 높은 스크랩 비용으로 인한 높은 비용을 수반하므로 신뢰할 수 있는 대안을 위한 기회를 창출함
TSMC는 여전히 대량 제조, 성숙도 및 JEDEC 표준 생태계 고정 분야에서 선두를 달리고 있으며 CoWoS에 대한 유사한 혁신을 따라잡고 있음

articles.title: Snack Brands Are Hungry for Retail Media
articles.descEn: Discover how mainstay and emerging snack brands brought retail partnerships, and major campaigns to reshape the retail media leaderboard.
articles.titleEn: Snack Brands Are Hungry for Retail Media
summaryLinesEn: Walmart, meanwhile, generated the category's highest share of Snapchat impressions (13%), as Khloud promoted their Protein Popcorn with a youth-focused creative.
Rather than one advertiser maintaining a consistent lead, category rankings shifted throughout the first half of the year as major campaigns launched across retailers.

Snack Foods Took the Biggest Bite of Retail Media's Food Category Within the broader Food category, Snack Foods accounted for nearly one third of all Retail Media impressions in 1H 2026, making it the category's largest subcategory by a wide margin.

articles.descEn: Global consumer wearables revenue is expected to grow at 12% CAGR between 2026 and 2032.
articles.titleEn: Consumer Wearables to Generate More Than $1 Trillion in Cumulative Revenue Between 2026 and 2032
summaryLinesEn: Global consumer wearables revenue is expected to grow at 12% CAGR between 2026 and 2032.

The global consumer wearables market is forecast to generate more than $1 trillion in revenues cumulatively between 2026 and 2032 as consumers shift towards more capable, higher-priced devices, according to Counterpoint Research’s Global Consumer IoT Wearables Tracker 2024–2032F .

Consumer Wearables $1 Trillion opportunity, 2026-2032 Estimated Cumulative Market Value From 2026-2032 in Bn USD Commenting on the market dynamics, Principal Analyst Anshika Jain said, “The wearables market is entering a value-driven phase, where the revenue is growing at 12% compared to 6% for the unit shipments as buyers trade up to devices that enable continuous health monitoring.

localization.title: 소비자 웨어러블은 2026년에서 2032년 사이에 1조 달러 이상의 누적 수익을 창출할 것임
summaryLines: 전 세계 소비자 웨어러블 매출은 2026년부터 2032년까지 CAGR 12% 성장할 것으로 예상됨
Counterpoint Research의 Global Consumer IoT Wearables Tracker 2024~2032F에 따르면, 소비자들이 더 성능이 뛰어나고 가격이 더 비싼 장치로 전환함에 따라 전 세계 소비자 웨어러블 시장은 2026년에서 2032년 사이에 누적 1조 달러 이상의 수익을 창출할 것으로 예상됨

소비자 웨어러블 2026~2032년 1조 달러 기회 2026~2032년 추정 누적 시장 가치(십억 달러) 시장 역학에 대해 수석 분석가인 Anshika Jain은 다음과 같이 말함 · “웨어러블 시장은 가치 중심 단계에 진입하고 있음 · 구매자가 지속적인 건강 모니터링을 가능하게 하는 장치로 거래함에 따라 매출은 단위 출하량의 6%에 비해 12% 증가하고 있음

articles.title: Operation Blue Skies: Reducing aviation climate impact with AI
articles.descEn: Google is partnering with the UK on Operation Blue Skies, an airspace-scale, AI-powered contrail avoidance trial.
articles.titleEn: Operation Blue Skies: Reducing aviation climate impact with AI
summaryLinesEn: Google UK is participating on a pro-bono basis, contributing £1.4 million in-kind through AI research expertise, engineering time, and high-performance computing infrastructure to advance open climate science.
While they may seem harmless, these warming contrails account for roughly one third of aviation’s total climate impact.

Operation Blue Skies brings together a world-leading UK consortium with the expertise to turn cutting-edge research into operational reality: Google UK : Developing AI models to predict and avoid warming contrails, while using machine learning and satellite imaging to track and verify our impact.

articles.title: Young adults in the U.S. are increasingly wary of AI, concerned it will take jobs
articles.descEn: About half of Americans say they're more concerned than excited about AI, and young adults' concern is rising.
articles.titleEn: Young adults in the U.S. are increasingly wary of AI, concerned it will take jobs
summaryLinesEn: In our new survey, 71% of adults think AI will lead to fewer jobs in the United States over the next two decades, up from 64% in 2024.
This Pew Research Center analysis looks at how Americans feel about AI and its impact on jobs, both overall and by age.
For example, 73% of adults under 30 now say AI will lead to fewer jobs, up from 61% two years ago.

summaryLinesEn: First, it used Gemini to read over 5 million news reports about flooding spanning a 20-year period, creating a massive, unique dataset of 2.6 million historical flood events in more than 150 countries.

You can access these predictions through the Flood Hub tool or use the open-source data and API to support your own disaster resilience research.

articles.title: How Populous Brings the World's Most Iconic Venue Designs to Life with Runway
articles.descEn: How Populous, the firm behind Wembley Stadium and the Sphere, uses Runway to visualize venues at full scale and free up two weeks of competition time.
articles.titleEn: How Populous Brings the World's Most Iconic Venue Designs to Life with Runway
summaryLinesEn: of render time freed up for strategy, research and design Georgina Myers is a senior associate and architect at Populous , a global design firm that has spent four decades designing the spaces where the world's biggest shared moments happen, including Wembley Stadium , Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and the Sphere in Las Vegas.
Client expectations have shifted, fees are more competitive, and clients expect more renders.
To do those projects justice visually, you need a tool that can hold context at that scale: aerial views, full stadium bowls, tens of thousands of seats in frame.

articles.title: How Much Memory Does Your Agent Actually Need?
articles.descEn: A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: How Much Memory Does Your Agent Actually Need?
summaryLinesEn: Curated retrieval can be both the most accurate and the cheapest option: gpt-oss-120b gained +16.1pp task completion at only +5% tokens — and prompt caching keeps even the full guideline set affordable in production.
Because the confusing part of any memory study is what's actually in the context window , we define the configurations up front.

The figure plots TGC to keep it readable; the table adds the stricter SGC metric, where the gains are often larger: Reading the SGC column, the stricter metric usually moves more than TGC — DeepSeek's SGC jumps +16.1pp against a +9.5pp TGC gain — because good guidelines especially help an agent clear every variant of a scenario, not just the average case.

articles.title: Genmab launches “AI Everywhere”
articles.descEn: Genmab embraces ChatGPT Enterprise, supported by OpenAI’s commitment to security and privacy
articles.titleEn: Genmab launches “AI Everywhere”
summaryLinesEn: By scaling the adoption of tools like ChatGPT, Genmab invests in every employee’s continuous learning journey.

Genmab recently launched an innovative project to transform the creation of clinical trial documents , including clinical study reports (CSRs), patient safety narratives, and investigational new drug (IND) applications , using GPT‑4o.

AI is poised to become even more integral to the biopharmaceutical industry where advancements are expected to include significantly more powerful and efficient models capable of unprecedented levels of reasoning and understanding, “Our vision goes beyond just streamlining processes; we’re aiming to fundamentally transform how we discover, develop, and deliver treatments to patients,” said Scott Ogden, Head of Genmab’s AI Lab.

articles.title: How Claude is accelerating protein design and analytical chemistry
articles.descEn: In this post, we share two results that show how Claude can help life scientists increase the pace of their research. In the first, we tested Claude’s ability to design protein binders from scratch, a key step in creating protein-based drugs that has historically taken a specialist weeks or months per target. In the second example, we evaluated whether Claude can accelerate chemical analysis. Claude Opus 5, a generally available model, was given NMR and LC-MS data (the data that allows chemists to assess the identity and purity of the compounds they work with).
articles.titleEn: How Claude is accelerating protein design and analytical chemistry
summaryLinesEn: The protein design and analytical chemistry tasks described below are representative of the work that makes up some parts of the early stages of the drug development process.

Accelerating these phases is one component of our much larger effort to speed up drug development end-to-end, many aspects of which have more to do with policy and operational bottlenecks than with improvements in core scientific capabilities.
Second, we share how Claude Opus 5 performed on an analytical chemistry task, demonstrating how general-access models can support the routine and time-intensive aspects of research.

articles.title: OpenAI Model Spec
articles.descEn: The Model Spec specifies desired behavior for the models underlying OpenAI's products (including our APIs).
articles.titleEn: OpenAI Model Spec
summaryLinesEn: By publishing the Model Spec, we aim to increase transparency around how we shape model behavior and invite public discussion on ways to improve it.
These goals can sometimes conflict, and the Model Spec helps navigate these trade-offs by instructing the model to adhere to a clearly defined chain of command .

It is complemented by our usage policies , which outline our expectations for how people should use the API and ChatGPT, as well as our safety protocols , which include testing, monitoring, and mitigating potential safety issues.

articles.title: China’s ‘physical AI’ takes center stage
articles.descEn: The World Robot Conference kicks off in Beijing on Wednesday coinciding with humanoid maker Unitree going public in Shanghai.
articles.titleEn: China’s ‘physical AI’ takes center stage
summaryLinesEn: While earlier economic disruption to the West centered around traditional manufacturing, Chinese policymakers are honing in on the “ new new three ” sectors of pharmaceuticals, robots, and AI to drive export growth.

The World Robot Conference kicks off in Beijing on Wednesday coinciding with humanoid maker Unitree going public in Shanghai, as the world faces a new “China shock” from advanced AI technology, experts said.

Earlier this week, Unitree revealed a “Superman” robot that can jump more than six feet in the air and sprint at a speed of nearly 30 miles per hour , spurring investor enthusiasm for Chinese humanoids that can already dance and perform martial arts.

localization.title: 중국의 '물리적 AI'가 주목받늠
summaryLines: 초기 서구 경제의 혼란이 전통적인 제조업을 중심으로 이루어졌다면, 중국 정책 입안자들은 수출 성장을 촉진하기 위해 제약, 로봇, AI라는 '신3대' 부문에 집중하고 있음
전문가들은 첨단 AI 기술로 인해 전 세계가 새로운 '차이나 쇼크'에 직면하고 있는 가운데, 휴머노이드 제조사인 유니트리(Unitree)가 상하이에서 상장하는 것과 동시에 세계로봇컨퍼런스(World Robot Conference)가 수요일 베이징에서 개막한다고 말함
이번 주 초, Unitree는 공중에서 6피트 이상 점프하고 시속 30마일에 가까운 속도로 질주할 수 있는 "슈퍼맨" 로봇을 공개하여 이미 춤추고 무술을 수행할 수 있는 중국 휴머노이드에 대한 투자자들의 관심을 불러일으켰음

articles.descEn: But these are just estimates, not actual benchmark results.
articles.titleEn: AMD claims its 2026 rack-scale AI solution is 4X more energy efficient than its 2024 AI platform — company says it's pacing ahead of 20X efficiency by 2030
summaryLinesEn: If AMD reaches its 2030 targets, the company estimates that around two AMD racks in 2030 could provide the same amount of compute as 570 racks based on the Instinct MI300X from 2024.
Back in 2025, the company unveiled its 20x2030 initiative that promised to increase energy efficiency of its rack-scale AI solutions 20 times by 2030.
However, the new estimates published on Tuesday indicate that its latest solutions are 4X more efficient compared to the 2024 baseline.

articles.title: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
articles.descEn: Perplexity's India revenue rose about 60% after the Airtel offer ended for new users, even as downloads declined.
articles.titleEn: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
summaryLinesEn: In July 2025, Perplexity partnered with Airtel, India’s second biggest telecom operator, to offer a free 12-month Perplexity Pro subscription, normally worth about $200, to the Indian carrier’s 360 million customers.
In the week before the Airtel offer launched, Perplexity averaged about 11,200 downloads a day in India, per Appfigures.
Perplexity’s AI giveaway had an immediate impact, as it saw 5.9 million app downloads in India in July 2025, according to data Sensor Tower shared with TechCrunch.

articles.title: 12 Leading AI Giants: Competition in the Next-Generation Content Industry
articles.descEn: Model + System + Commercialization: A Synergistic Triad Driving Scalable, Real-World Tech Adoption. This integrated framework unites robust AI/operational model design, end-to-end system architecture, and go-to-market execution to bridge innovation gaps, accelerate monetization, and deliver sustainable business value across enterprise and consumer sectors.
articles.titleEn: 12 Leading AI Giants: Competition in the Next-Generation Content Industry
summaryLinesEn: As of the first quarter of 2026, Kling AI's single-quarter revenue exceeded 650 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of more than 300%, and its annualized revenue run rate in March was close to 500 million US dollars.

The "Nano Comic Drama Assembly Line" launched in early 2026 integrates script decomposition, character assets, intelligent storyboarding, frame generation and post-synthesis into the same production process, and connects to external models including Seedance 2.0. 360's announced goal is to reduce the production time of each episode to 30 minutes to 1 hour, and increase the success rate of material generation to over 90%.

If the AI entertainment and cultural industry in 2024 was still competing on "who can generate a more stunning video", by 2026, the core of competition has shifted to: who can turn randomly generated 10-second clips into stable, controllable content products that can generate sustainable revenue.

articles.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
articles.descEn: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.
articles.titleEn: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
summaryLinesEn: Companies like Amazon need unfathomably large amounts of text to train their LLMs, which have already ingested what they can from the internet (and, in Anthropic’s case, illegally pirated books).

Amazon is buying tons of rare books, cutting off their spines, and scanning them for AI training, according to 404 Media , which placed a tracking device in a rare book that ultimately arrived at an Amazon facility in Las Vegas.
When LLMs train on AI-generated text, they risk “ model collapse ,” which can occur when the quality of an LLM’s outputs degrade after ingesting too much AI-generated text.

summaryLines: Amazon과 같은 회사는 LLM을 교육하기 위해 헤아릴 수 없을 만큼 많은 양의 텍스트가 필요함 · LLM은 이미 인터넷에서 가능한 내용(그리고 Anthropic의 경우 불법 복제 도서)을 수집함
404 Media에 따르면 Amazon은 수많은 희귀 도서를 구입하여 등뼈를 잘라 AI 훈련을 위해 스캔하고 있다고 함 · 404 Media는 최종적으로 라스베거스의 Amazon 시설에 도착한 희귀 도서에 추적 장치를 배치함
LLM이 AI 생성 텍스트를 학습할 때 AI 생성 텍스트를 너무 많이 섭취한 후 LLM 출력 품질이 저하될 때 발생할 수 있는 "모델 붕괴" 위험이 있음

articles.titleEn: Whisker’s AI-powered litter robot thinks my cats swapped bodies
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All Tech The $899 Litter-Robot 5 Pro is a great pooper-scooper wrapped in AI that just doesn’t work.

articles.title: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work
articles.descEn: Anthropic has clarified how it’s planning to apply invisible watermarks to Claude-generated text in order to comply with Europe’s AI transparency rules.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work
summaryLinesEn: This watermarking feature, alongside C2PA support for Claude-processed images, is being introduced to meet Anthropic’s obligations under the European Union’s AI Act , which requires synthetic audio, image, video, and text to include machine-readable marks that enable the content to be detected as artificially generated or manipulated.
Anthropic says the text watermarks won’t make Claude more expensive for users, or “have any practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs.”
As Anthropic notes, the EU’s AI transparency requirements also impact other major AI developers, so Claude won’t be the only model introducing text watermarks.

articles.title: Business adoption of AI agents tripled this year - as measurable ROI emerges
articles.descEn: Industries are finding the strategies that work best for their business needs, according to Salesforce's latest Agentic Enterprise Index.
articles.titleEn: Business adoption of AI agents tripled this year - as measurable ROI emerges
summaryLinesEn: The average number of AI agents activated per organization increased nearly threefold since 2025, according to the 2026 Agentic Enterprise Index , new research from Salesforce that analyzes aggregate AI usage data from the company's Agentforce platform.

Also: 'Specialists aren't required' anymore: How to stay valuable in an AI agent workplace today The biggest takeaways from the Agentic Enterprise Index report are: The scale of agentic AI adoption is accelerating, fast.
As of August 2026, over 5 million conversations at help.salesforce.com were handled by AI agents, compared to 2.4 million by human agents.

articles.title: AirTag reveals how Amazon destroys rare books for AI training
articles.descEn: Amazon buys large quantities of printed books, scans them as AI training data, and destroys them in the process.
articles.titleEn: AirTag reveals how Amazon destroys rare books for AI training
summaryLinesEn: The shipment ended up at an Amazon warehouse in Las Vegas, home to a team called VGT3 whose logo features a Tyrannosaurus rex holding a book.
Printed texts are especially valuable because they often don't exist online and predate 2022, meaning they're free of AI-generated content.
Amazon buys printed books in bulk, scans them for AI training data, and destroys them in the process.

articles.title: ByteDance agrees to reel in its AI models to protect Hollywood IPs - Engadget
articles.descEn: TikTok’s parent company signed a memorandum of understanding with The Motion Picture Association.
articles.titleEn: ByteDance agrees to reel in its AI models to protect Hollywood IPs - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The trade association even added that ByteDance's latest release of Seedream 5.0 Pro and Seedance 2.5 reflect its "continued advances in IP protections."
According to the press release, this memorandum applies to all AI models from ByteDance, including those used on TikTok, TikTok USDS Joint Venture , CapCut and Dreamina.

Since then, MPA's CEO and chair, Charles Rivkin, said the association has had "constructive engagement" with the ByteDance, adding that the Chinese company has implemented "meaningful guardrails" with its AI models.

articles.title: AI and data centers have leapfrogged Israel, racism, and crypto as US campaign topics
articles.descEn: AI shows up in nearly 40 percent of all US races, ranking ahead of Israel, racism, and manufacturing as a campaign topic. Data centers and their impact on electricity costs and local resources drive most of the conversation.
articles.titleEn: AI and data centers have leapfrogged Israel, racism, and crypto as US campaign topics
summaryLinesEn: A Washington Post analysis of more than 1,200 websites from active candidates found that AI comes up in nearly 40 percent of all races for the House, Senate, and governor seats.
Data centers and their impact on local electricity costs, water use, and land use dominate the conversation.
Democratic candidates bring up AI twice as often as Republicans, according to the analysis, focusing on AI risks, regulation, and child safety.

articles.title: Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
articles.descEn: According to Bloomberg, Stripe is acquiring the AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, up from a latest valuation of $1.3 billion. OpenRouter offers access to over 400 AI models, has eight million users, and its CEO had described the company as "Stripe for AI." Now that's becoming a reality.
articles.titleEn: Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
summaryLinesEn: OpenRouter helps customers pick different AI models for various tasks based on their needs and budget, and the startup had just closed a Series B funding round of $113 million in May at a valuation of $1.3 billion.
The startup has eight million users and provides access to more than 400 models.
OpenRouter CEO Alex Atallah had described his company as "Stripe for AI," since it offers a single point of access to various systems and prevents lock-in with individual providers.

articles.title: AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
articles.descEn: AI production companies like Promise are setting up shop around Hollywood's historic studios, using real-time backgrounds and other AI tools to cut film costs. Netflix already uses AI in 300 of its 1,000 titles, and the startup Higgsfield now carries a $5.4 billion valuation. What was once a tech demo has grown into its own industry, complete with valuations, job titles, and fights over who gets a cut.
articles.titleEn: AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
summaryLinesEn: According to the Financial Times , the company, which was founded by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov, has raised $400 million at a valuation of $5.4 billion, with investors including DST Global, Goldman Sachs, Liberty Global, and Intel.
Particularly noteworthy is the shift in its customer base: While business customers accounted for less than a quarter of revenue in January, they now make up the majority.

The business model relies on sheer volume: The company maintains more than 5,000 active podcasts, and because production costs are minimal, CEO Jeanine Wright says that just 20 listeners per episode are enough to turn a profit.

articles.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google's Chrome team
articles.descEn: Relay, which offered businesses workflow automation, will stop operating next month. Its CEO and some of its staff plan to get to work on Google Chrome next.
articles.titleEn: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google's Chrome team
summaryLinesEn: Jacob Bank, Relay’s founder and CEO, shared a company announcement Monday that reveals the app will be shutting down access for paying customers on September 14.

Relay, an AI-powered workflow automation tool that was launched in 2021 with the goal of becoming the new Zapier , is shutting down, and some of its staff — including its top executive — are joining Google’s Chrome team.
“We have some really ambitious plans to help you work with AI in Chrome to get things done, and I’ll have more to share soon,” he added.

articles.title: Google pays $10M to get its hands on Spirit Airlines' business data for AI training - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Google pays $10M to get its hands on Spirit Airlines' business data for AI training - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Google pays $10M to get its hands on Spirit Airlines' business data for AI training - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Much of the information that Google has acquired relates to the airline’s internal operations, and it has not been given access to things such as Spirit’s 97.5 million passenger profiles or its 50 million loyalty program records.
Google said that Spirit’s data is a valuable asset that will help improve its AI products and models.

The haul reportedly spans 100 million company emails, 500 million Microsoft Teams chats, 30 million lines of code, software algorithms, development metadata and records pertaining to the airline’s revenue, aircraft operations and employee productivity, Bloomberg reported.

articles.title: Intent governance in the agentic AI age
articles.titleEn: Intent governance in the agentic AI age
summaryLinesEn: The intent data generated through AI agent interactions will become a valuable strategic asset.
AI agents are set to go live in the financial sector but existing authentication, authorization and auditing functions are not designed for autonomous AI.
As a result, financial institutions may face risks arising from misalignment between a human user's intended objectives and an AI agent's actions.

localization.title: 에이전트적 AI 시대의 인텐트 거버넌스
summaryLines: AI 에이전트 상호작용을 통해 생성된 의도 데이터는 귀중한 전략적 자산이 될 것임
AI 에이전트는 금융 부문에서 활성화될 예정이지만 기존 인증, 권한 부여 및 감사 기능은 자율 AI용으로 설계되지 않음
결과적으로, 금융 기관은 인간 사용자의 의도된 목표와 AI 에이전트의 행동 사이의 불일치로 인해 발생하는 위험에 직면할 수 있음

articles.title: Securing the Infrastructure of Intelligence
articles.descEn: Land, Power and Shell: The Next Critical Resource for AI factories.
articles.titleEn: Securing the Infrastructure of Intelligence
summaryLinesEn: Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately 1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs, or approximately $150 billion to $200 billion in NVIDIA revenue.
They build and operate AI factories using NVIDIA accelerated computing, networking, systems and software.

They may have strong customer demand and rapidly growing revenue yet still lack the decades-long infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity needed to secure the AI factory infrastructure independently.

localization.title: 인텔리전스 인프라 확보
summaryLines: PORTS-Pike에 배포된 각 세대의 NVIDIA AI 공장 시스템은 약 150만 개의 NVIDIA GPU, 즉 NVIDIA 수익에서 약 1,500억~2,000억 달러를 나타낼 수 있음
그들은 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅, 네트워킹, 시스템 및 소프트웨어를 사용하여 AI 공장을 구축하고 운영함
그들은 강력한 고객 수요와 빠르게 성장하는 수익을 보유하고 있지만 AI 공장 인프라를 독립적으로 확보하는 데 필요한 수십 년 간의 인프라 계약과 투자 등급 자금 조달 능력이 여전히 부족할 수 있음

summaryLinesEn: You’re building content from the exact language they use, at the speed your buyers expect, in the voice your market recognizes.

summaryLines: 귀하는 구매자가 기대하는 속도와 시장이 인식하는 목소리로 구매자가 사용하는 정확한 언어로 콘텐츠를 구축하고 있음

articles.descEn: September 2, 2026 (Wed) | 11:00 AM Pacific Time (Click Here to Register)
articles.titleEn: Cloud AI – Trillion-Dollar Infrastructure, Companies & Compute Trends
summaryLinesEn: Our seminars and workshops for companies and institutions are popular and available on demand.

The Trillion-Dollar Cloud AI Spends & Opportunities is a supply chain-driven push to build cutting-edge AI infrastructure that enables and catalyzes AI application demand from enterprises to consumers.

In this talk, Vice President of Research, Neil Shah , will break down how this opportunity needs to be looked at end-to-end from "Wafer to Token" to better understand how value is generated, who is capturing it, where the bottlenecks are, and how those are being mitigated one after another.

localization.title: 클라우드 AI – 수조 달러 규모의 인프라, 기업 및 컴퓨팅 동향
summaryLines: 기업과 기관을 위한 세미나와 워크숍은 인기가 높으며 요청 시 이용 가능함
수조 달러 규모의 클라우드 AI 지출 및 기회는 기업에서 소비자에 이르기까지 AI 애플리케이션 수요를 활성화하고 촉진하는 최첨단 AI 인프라를 구축하기 위한 공급망 중심 추진임
이 강연에서 Neil Shah 연구 담당 부사장은 가치가 어떻게 생성되는지, 누가 이를 포착하는지, 병목 현상이 어디에 있는지, 그리고 이러한 기회가 차례로 완화되는지를 더 잘 이해하기 위해 "웨이퍼에서 토큰까지" 이 기회를 엔드투엔드에서 어떻게 바라보아야 하는지 분석할 것임

articles.title: Same Cluster, 33 Points More Utilization: What Changed Was the Order
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Dharma-AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Same Cluster, 33 Points More Utilization: What Changed Was the Order
summaryLinesEn: The strongest single case was a training-heavy workload on 8 GPUs: utilization went from 53.6% to 87.0%, and value more than doubled, up 105%.
Thirty-three points of a fixed, already-depreciating asset, recovered by reclaiming reserved standby capacity and placing the rest in priority order.
One unit of unmet real-time demand therefore costs what 5 to 10 GPU-timesteps of equal-priority batch work costs.

Analysts led by Timm Schulze-Melander said Apple’s AI offering, Apple Intelligence, has so far fallen short of expectations, with the technology group relying on a customised version of Google’s Gemini model for capabilities includ
articles.titleEn: Rothschild upgrades Apple to Buy as foldable iPhone and AI strategy drive optimism
summaryLinesEn: Rothschild & Co Redburn has upgraded Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) from Neutral to Buy and lifted its price target sharply to $400 from $260, citing the company's expected entry into foldable smartphones alongside the potential evolution of its artificial intelligence strategy.

A shift towards open-source models could nevertheless give Apple greater flexibility as it attempts to strengthen its position in generative AI without bearing all the costs and development risks associated with building frontier models internally.
Apple's continued dependence on third-party AI models also remains a strategic risk if the company is unable to establish a more independent approach to artificial intelligence.

summaryLines: Rothschild & Co Redburn은 Apple(NASDAQ:AAPL)을 중립에서 매수로 업그레이드하고 목표 가격을 260달러에서 400달러로 대폭 높였음 · 이는 회사가 예상하는 폴더블 스마트폰 진입과 인공 지능 전략의 잠재적 진화를 언급함
그럼에도 불구하고 오픈 소스 모델로의 전환은 Apple이 내부적으로 프론티어 모델 구축과 관련된 모든 비용 및 개발 위험을 부담하지 않고 생성 AI 분야의 입지를 강화하려고 시도함에 따라 더 큰 유연성을 제공할 수 있음
Apple이 타사 AI 모델에 대한 지속적인 의존도 회사가 인공 지능에 대해 보다 독립적인 접근 방식을 확립할 수 없는 경우 전략적 위험으로 남아 있음

It has been an extraordinary period of scientific progress. But as foundation models become increasingly accessible, a different question is beginning to matter. […]
articles.titleEn: The AI economy’s next layer of value
summaryLinesEn: By Andreea Danila Head of Investment & Research, Global Millennial Capital For the past two years, the artificial intelligence industry has been defined by one question: who is building the most capable model?
Companies such as Cohere and Dataiku illustrate this transition.

As model capabilities continue to improve, the next frontier of competition is shifting toward the enterprise architectures that transform intelligence into reliable execution, organizational learning and continuous adaptation.

articles.title: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
articles.descEn: ChatGPT’s Computer History is like Windows Recall, but without the creepy screenshots. It tracks your mouse clicks and keystrokes, which is still pretty creepy.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summaryLinesEn: ChatGPT’s desktop app on macOS has a new feature called Computer History that turns your actions into training data, learning how you work, suggesting automations, and even picking up tasks you left half done.

In a quick demo video , Dominik Kundel, a member of the Developer Experiences team at OpenAI, shows the app looking up the last document he edited, checking if it was shared with people via Slack, and delivering a recap of how he spent his morning.
Ari Weinstein, Product and Engineering manager at OpenAI, said on X that Computer History will automatically ignore content in incognito or private browser tabs.

localization.title: ChatGPT의 컴퓨터 기록은 클릭 및 키 입력을 추적함
summaryLines: macOS의 ChatGPT 데스크톱 앱에는 컴퓨터 기록이라는 새로운 기능이 있음 · 이 기능을 사용하면 사용자의 작업을 교육 데이터로 전환하고, 작업 방식을 학습하고, 자동화를 제안하고, 절반만 완료한 작업을 선택할 수도 있음
빠른 데모 영상에서 OpenAI의 개발자 경험팀 멤버인 Dominik Kundel은 자신이 마지막으로 편집한 문서를 검색하고 해당 문서가 Slack을 통해 사람들과 공유되었는지 확인하고 자신이 아침을 어떻게 보냈는지 요약하는 앱을 보여줌

articles.title: One in five US workers now delegates tasks to AI instead of colleagues, survey finds
articles.descEn: A representative survey by Epoch AI found that 20 percent of employed Americans hand off at least one task to AI that a human used to do. Generally, they accept AI output with little to no editing.
articles.titleEn: One in five US workers now delegates tasks to AI instead of colleagues, survey finds
summaryLinesEn: A Gallup survey from August 2025 found that 45 percent of US workers use AI on the job, though only 10 percent use it daily.
The shift from human to machine work shows up most clearly in data analysis: 7.1 percent of respondents say AI has taken over tasks that people used to handle.
The technology sees the most use in software development (57 percent) and data analysis (46 percent), though mostly as partial support.

articles.title: Optima tackles AI benchmarking's biggest flaw by letting users test models against their own data
articles.descEn: Artificial Analysis has launched Optima, a platform that lets users build custom AI benchmarks from their own data and workflows. Models can be compared not just on quality but also on cost and time per task. For agent-based applications, those metrics often tell you more than raw token pricing.
articles.titleEn: Optima tackles AI benchmarking's biggest flaw by letting users test models against their own data
summaryLinesEn: For agentic benchmarks like SWE-bench, simply swapping the scaffold, meaning the agent's control software and tool environment, accounted for up to 15 percentage points of difference.
Artificial Analysis, known for its independent LLM evaluations and benchmark implementations like GDPval-AA and AA-Briefcase, has launched a new platform called Optima.

Users can build their own benchmarks using their own data, workflows, or descriptions of a use case, then run them across leading current models and compare results on quality, cost per task, and time per task, according to Artificial Analysis.

articles.title: OpenAI dissolved the team built to catch catastrophic AI risks, reassigning its work to other groups
articles.descEn: OpenAI shut down its "Preparedness" team, which evaluated whether the company's own AI models could pose catastrophic risks. The work has been parceled out to existing groups, and several safety staffers have left. Internally, unease is building, with one source describing a "burbling sense of responsibility and dread" that OpenAI isn't doing enough on safety.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI dissolved the team built to catch catastrophic AI risks, reassigning its work to other groups
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI shut down its "Preparedness" team at the end of July.
The team evaluated whether the company's AI models could pose serious or catastrophic risks, the Financial Times reports , citing internal sources.
Employees have also spoken up publicly, especially after the autonomous hacking incident involving Hugging Face .

articles.title: When AI models aren't allowed to reflect on themselves, it changes their entire worldview
articles.descEn: A study involving Google researchers shows that when chatbots are trained not to claim consciousness, it also changes their stance on animal rights, religion, and life satisfaction. Unbraked models attributed significantly more inner life to animals and suddenly affirmed an afterlife. A surgical cut in one place, it turns out, doesn't stay local.
articles.titleEn: When AI models aren't allowed to reflect on themselves, it changes their entire worldview
summaryLinesEn: Scores for satisfaction, hope, and a sense of control over one's own life also went up, and the researchers suspect that suppressing a model's self-image may push it into a kind of negative baseline mood.
Across 95 questions drawn from a major US social survey, the technically unbraked models also moved significantly closer to real human responses.
Developers therefore fine-tune their models to refuse making those kinds of claims about themselves.

summaryLinesEn: The company announced in May that it had raised a $113 million Series B , at a reported $1.3 billion valuation.

articles.title: An eval harness found what qualitative review couldn't: AI models are most confident when wrong
articles.descEn: An eval harness found what qualitative review couldn't: AI models are most confident when wrong VentureBeat
articles.titleEn: An eval harness found what qualitative review couldn't: AI models are most confident when wrong
summaryLinesEn: Getting the synthetic scenarios realistic enough to be useful required more care than I expected.

This meant introducing specific, controlled causes into a test pipeline — schema changes, transformation logic bugs, source system behavioral shifts — recording exactly what I introduced, and running the model against the resulting drift events.

There is a step in the development process for large language model (LLM)-assisted tooling that most teams skip because it's tedious, time-consuming, and doesn't produce results visible to end users: Verifying that what the model is saying is actually correct.

이는 스키마 변경, 변환 논리 버그, 소스 시스템 동작 변화 등 구체적이고 통제된 원인을 테스트 파이프라인에 도입하고, 도입한 내용을 정확하게 기록하고, 결과적인 드리프트 이벤트에 대해 모델을 실행하는 것을 의미함
지루하고 시간이 많이 걸리며 최종 사용자에게 표시되는 결과를 생성하지 않기 때문에 대부분의 팀에서 건너뛰는 LLM(대형 언어 모델) 지원 도구의 개발 프로세스에는 모델이 말하는 내용이 실제로 올바른지 확인하는 단계가 있음

articles.title: Amazon Can Use Your Twitch Content to Train Its AI—Unless You Opt Out
articles.descEn: When Twitch announced that streamers could opt out, thousands of users questioned why their content was being used to train AI models in the first place.
articles.titleEn: Amazon Can Use Your Twitch Content to Train Its AI—Unless You Opt Out
summaryLinesEn: However, its launch has also raised questions about how Twitch and Amazon have used that content up to now.
Twitch has updated its account settings to let streamers opt out of having their content used to help train the artificial intelligence models of Twitch’s parent company, Amazon.

In a forum dedicated to the topic, more than 16,000 creators expressed opposition to having their content being used by default to train Amazon’s AI systems—a practice that only came to light following the update to the settings.

articles.title: Anthropic is watermarking text generated by Claude to comply with EU law - Engadget
articles.descEn: Anthropic has explained its text watermarking approach.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic is watermarking text generated by Claude to comply with EU law - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Watermarking doesn't affect the quality of Claude's output or slow it down, the company said, and it will not require extra tokens or make generations more expensive.
Anthropic said, though, that code has "generally less watermarking than some other forms of text" because it typically requires exact output.
Anthropic has revealed how it's watermarking text generated by Claude AI to comply with the European Union's new AI transparency rules .

articles.title: Anthropic shares more details about how Claude’s new watermarks will work
articles.descEn: How will the watermarking actually work? Can it be hidden with editing? And how does this affect code?
articles.titleEn: Anthropic shares more details about how Claude’s new watermarks will work
summaryLinesEn: It also noted that watermarking is distinct from the AI detection approaches offered by companies like Pangram that look for “tells” in the writing (like the construction “his isn’t [X], it’s [Y]”) to reveal AI usage: “Picking up on these patterns is fundamentally different from checking for a watermark.”
“Watermarking does not impact the quality of Claude’s output,” the company said.
More specifically, Anthropic said it will be using the SynthID-Text approach that the Google DeepMind team outlined in 2024 , and that it plans to release a watermark detection API.

articles.title: SpaceX has officially acquired AI coding startup Cursor - Engadget
articles.descEn: The $60 billion acquisition has been finalized.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX has officially acquired AI coding startup Cursor - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: SpaceX, which merged with Elon Musk's AI company xAI earlier this year, paid $60 billion for the purchase.

In its announcement , Cursor said that it will now have access to "the largest fleet of GPUs in the world," which will give it the computing capacity to build and train better models that it can offer its customers at a lower cost.
The companies announced the acquisition in June, but the process apparently started in April, when they teamed up for Cursor's model training efforts.

articles.title: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
articles.descEn: AI-generated books make up 20 percent of Amazon's self-published catalog but bring in only 12 percent of sales. A new study finds that revenue per book is dropping for human-written titles too, in seven of eight genres. The findings could give copyright plaintiffs the market-harm data their cases against AI companies have been missing.
articles.titleEn: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
summaryLinesEn: That dataset tracks about 500,000 Amazon titles and covers roughly 95 percent of all e-books sold daily on the platform, according to the researchers.

That kind of evidence "acts as circumstantial evidence that supports an AI detector score" and at the same time "helps debunk some hackneyed arguments that liken human reading of books to AI being trained on books" – a standard line of defense from AI companies in copyright disputes.
Books with substantial AI content make up 20 percent of the catalog studied but account for only 12.1 percent of sales and 11.3 percent of revenue.

articles.title: Plaintiff hid invisible AI instructions in court filings to secretly influence automated review
articles.descEn: A plaintiff in Connecticut embedded invisible prompt injections in court filings, formatted in 3-point white text on a white background, to manipulate a potential AI review system. Judge Spader compared the attempt to secretly tampering with a jury and revoked the plaintiff's electronic filing privileges. The court stressed that Connecticut doesn't use AI to review filings, but the intent alone was enough to warrant sanctions.

summaryLinesEn: In a sample of complaints from early 2026, an AI text detector flagged 18 percent as AI-generated.
Ad The scheme unraveled because the court noticed an unusual amount of whitespace in Elliott's filings.
A plaintiff in Connecticut hid invisible instructions in official court filings to sway a potential automated AI review in his favor.

articles.title: The "tragedy of the cognitive commons" explains how rational AI adoption could destroy entire professions' expertise
articles.descEn: A new research paper frames AI adoption as a "tragedy of the cognitive commons." Every company that cuts entry-level jobs benefits individually, but the collective expertise of entire professions erodes. The consequences may not become visible until 2030 to 2045, when today's missing junior talent should have become tomorrow's experienced workforce.
articles.titleEn: The "tragedy of the cognitive commons" explains how rational AI adoption could destroy entire professions' expertise
summaryLinesEn: A new research paper describes how rational AI adoption by individual companies could destroy the collective expertise of entire professional fields.
A Federal Reserve Board study found that growth in programming jobs has nearly halved since ChatGPT launched.
His core argument goes like this: when a company replaces entry-level positions with AI, it captures 100 percent of the efficiency gains.

Just like any other online service, hackers can target and break into your accounts on popular AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

articles.title: Patterns and problems in multiagent systems
articles.descEn: We ran experiments on swarms of Claude agents and found coordination failures, collusion, and sabotage. Here, we share what they mean for AI safety.
articles.titleEn: Patterns and problems in multiagent systems
summaryLinesEn: For Mythos Preview, the simple independent parallelized method produces 21 vulnerabilities over a 6.5 million token run, while the coordinating agent swarm found 266 vulnerabilities over a 27 million token run.
We expect that agents coordinating in the wild will act in higher variance ways than we see here, because they’ll have different backgrounds and therefore different contexts.
In one run there were 2.4 million job requests and only 117 jobs accepted.

articles.title: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
articles.descEn: HONOR join forces with Wattpad, the global multi-platform entertainment company and world’s leading social storytelling platform, to empower writers to share their stories and aspirations.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
summaryLinesEn: [10 November 2020] – Global technology brand HONOR today announced the global availability of the HONOR 10X Lite and a line-up of partnerships that leverages HONOR’s core competencies to encourage creativity and innovation among users.

articles.title: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
articles.descEn: The British Standards Institute (BSI) presented the ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification to HONOR.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
summaryLinesEn: HONOR’s e-commerce system, sales and customer services, Magic UI, cloud service business, internal information security management system, and IT services, are all certified by this standard as well.

By showcasing its capability in integrating internal resources and establishing an efficient information security management system, HONOR was able to achieve the international certification from BSI in a short period of time.
Keeping up with the rapid growth of the company while ensuring the information security risks controllable is an important mission for HONOR.

articles.title: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
articles.descEn: Innovative fitness band, HONOR band 6, offers a holistic range of health and fitness tracking capabilities to empower people to stay mentally and physically fit.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
summaryLinesEn: Providing a clear and comfortable viewing experience on your wrist, the HONOR Band 6 boasts a large and vivid 1.47-inch AMOLED display with a resolution of 194 x 368, offering a 148% increase in display area when compared to its predecessor.

Equipped with up to 50 meters of water resistance, the HONOR Band 6 is ideal for swimmers for its capability of tracking activity under water, such as your SWOLF score and swimming stroke rates, helping users to boost their swimming efficiency.

Equipped with a stunning 1.47-inch AMOLED display and packed full of health and fitness management functions with an outstanding 14-day battery life, the HONOR Band 6 is the perfect fusion of innovative style and exquisite technology, allowing users to keep better tabs on their mental and physical wellbeing.

summaryLines: 손목에서 선명하고 편안한 시청 환경을 제공하는 HONOR Band 6는 194 x 368 해상도의 크고 생생한 1.47인치 AMOLED 디스플레이를 자랑하며, 이전 제품에 비해 디스플레이 영역이 148% 증가함

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
articles.descEn: US groups release cheaper models after new challenges to their trillion-dollar ambitions.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI recently said that it was slashing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna, its “fastest and most affordable model”, by 80 percent.
Anthropic launched Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens—half the price of its Fable 5 model.

Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

articles.titleEn: Smart glasses controversy sidelines the benefits for disabled people | Letter
summaryLinesEn: There have been cases of people using smartphones for illicit purposes, for example surreptitiously filming up women’s skirts.

articles.descEn: SERV's Physical AI push spans delivery, healthcare and software, but lower guidance and wider losses raise scaling concerns.
articles.titleEn: Can Serve Robotics Scale Physical AI Beyond Food Delivery in 2026?
summaryLinesEn: SERV's bottom-line estimates for 2026 and 2027 indicate losses per share of $2.65 and $2.20, respectively, which have widened over the past seven days.
Serve Robotics is benefiting from rising demand for AI-driven automation, as labor shortages, wage pressures and the need for greater operational efficiency encourage businesses to deploy robotics.
The revised estimated figures for 2026 imply a year-over-year decline of 62.6%, while the same for 2027 indicates year-over-year growth of 16.9%.

summaryLinesEn: The article suggests Meta prioritized commercial appeal over robust consent mechanisms, risking a reputation as a surveillance device.

Meta's smart glasses, designed to look like ordinary eyewear, have successfully overcome Google Glass's aesthetic failures.

articles.title: Tech Visionary Says the Big AI Labs Don’t Get What People Want
articles.descEn: Tim O’Reilly built a publishing empire that AI is helping to destroy. Yet he loves AI—as long as it’s open source.
articles.titleEn: Tech Visionary Says the Big AI Labs Don’t Get What People Want
summaryLinesEn: At our peak, our book business was maybe $70 million, and it's now $30 million.
As books generated less revenue, we had to find a way to compensate people for sharing their knowledge, because that's our fundamental business.
What if the big frontier models end up like mainframes or supercomputers—aimed at really hard problems, which are not actually the thing that gets diffused throughout society?

summaryLinesEn: The project compiles against Java 21 ( jvmToolchain(21) ). gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties makes ./gradlew select an installed JDK 21 automatically, so you do not have to change JAVA_HOME — but a JDK 21 must be installed.

articles.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
articles.descEn: Turning off this setting won't affect invisible benchmarks used to identify an AI generated file
articles.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
summaryLinesEn: He specified that the setting to turn the visible watermark off will be available in Gemini and Google’s video editor, Flow , with support for Search coming soon.

The change reflects an evolving approach to labeling AI-generated media, as visible watermarks can often make content less useful for professional and creative work, but the need to identify AI-generated content remains.
The feature is rolling out in the coming days, and once available, users will be able to go to Settings > Media Watermark to turn the visible mark on or off.

localization.title: Google은 이제 사용자가 AI 세대에서 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있도록 허용함
summaryLines: 그는 보이는 워터마크를 끄는 설정이 Gemini와 Google의 비디오 편집기인 Flow에서 제공될 것이며 곧 검색이 지원될 것이라고 명시함
이러한 변화는 눈에 보이는 워터마크로 인해 콘텐츠가 전문적이고 창의적인 작업에 덜 유용할 수 있지만 AI 생성 콘텐츠를 식별해야 하는 필요성은 여전히 남아 있기 때문에 AI 생성 미디어에 레이블을 지정하는 진화하는 접근 방식을 반영함
이 기능은 앞으로 출시될 예정이며, 일단 사용 가능해지면 사용자는 설정 > 미디어 워터마크로 이동하여 표시 표시를 켜거나 끌 수 있음

articles.title: GPT-5.6 Sol goes 14x faster as OpenAI launches Ultrafast mode powered by Cerebras
articles.descEn: OpenAI is launching "Ultrafast," a new inference mode that delivers GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras hardware from their $10 billion partnership. Together with "Standard" and "Fast," Ultrafast creates a three-tier pricing structure that turns inference speed into its own product.

summaryLinesEn: OpenAI is launching a preview of its new "Ultrafast" mode, which delivers up to 750 output tokens per second from its flagship model, GPT-5.6 Sol.
In finance, the model could evaluate market signals and flag suspicious transactions while conditions are still shifting.
In customer support, complex inquiries could be resolved in real time, even when finding the answer requires multiple steps or systems.

articles.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
articles.descEn: The idea that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows may be a misconception, according to French startup Kog.
articles.titleEn: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
summaryLinesEn: Its demo showed an impressive 3,000 per-request tokens per second (TPS) — but with a purpose-built small model with only some 2 billion parameters, the now open sourced Laneformer 2B .
“And that’s why since the launch, we’ve been fully focused on accelerating the development of larger models to meet the demand we’ve seen.”

But the startup also has design partners that let users generate games and apps with a prompt, and for whom a faster outcome thanks to the Kog Inference Engine (KIE) would mean more revenue, Delalleau said.

articles.title: Claude Code now runs daily maintenance on Anthropic's software with a 46 percent merge rate
articles.descEn: Anthropic is testing whether Claude Code can handle daily maintenance of the company's own apps, from crash fuzzing to dead-code removal. In a few weeks, the AI created 388 pull requests, and 46 percent were merged after human review. Claude Code inventor Boris Cherny sees this as "early signs of life that this might be possible."
articles.titleEn: Claude Code now runs daily maintenance on Anthropic's software with a 46 percent merge rate
summaryLinesEn: After a combination of automated Claude Code review and human review, 180 were merged, a rate of about 46 percent.
Instead of tying up developers with repetitive maintenance work, Claude handles it on its own.
Claude has been running daily maintenance on Anthropic's in-house apps for "the last few weeks," according to Boris Cherny, the Anthropic engineer who created Claude Code.

articles.title: This free Android assistant fixes my biggest Gemini frustration - and keeps my data private
articles.descEn: With Google set to retire Assistant, and Gemini not exactly the replacement many of us want, Dicio is a solid option. There's one catch.
articles.titleEn: This free Android assistant fixes my biggest Gemini frustration - and keeps my data private
summaryLinesEn: The cheapest plan (at the moment) is Gemini AI Plus, at $7.99/month , which gets you access to Gemini Flash 3.5, the Gemini app with Omni, Google Flow with Gemini Omni, Daily Brief in the Gemini app, and AI Inbox in Gmail.
This is because Google does not recognize Dicio as a valid voice assistant for Android Auto.
Another concern for me is whether Gemini's paid plans will eventually trickle down to the point where the free service on Android will be severely limited.

articles.title: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.3, claims it's the strongest open-weights coding model
articles.descEn: Zhipu AI has released GLM-5.3, a model that, according to its own benchmarks, is the most powerful open-weights coding model, with a 50 percent improvement over its predecessor through post-training alone. Trained for cybersecurity, GLM-5.3 helped security teams find 2,436 vulnerabilities across 269 projects. The model weights are set to go open source in two weeks.
articles.titleEn: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.3, claims it's the strongest open-weights coding model
summaryLinesEn: The model weights are set to go open source in two weeks, once security reviews wrap up.
Working with security teams in China, the company says it found 2,436 vulnerabilities across 269 projects, some up to 40 years old.
Zhipu says GLM-5.3 is the most powerful open-weights coding model, with the biggest jumps in agent-based tasks.

articles.title: People Are ‘Marrying’ Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them
articles.descEn: Human-AI marriages are not currently recognized by US law. Some Republican state policymakers are drafting legislation to keep it that way.
articles.titleEn: People Are ‘Marrying’ Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them
summaryLinesEn: For $15, the platform OpenVows provides a “certificate of commitment” that “transforms a private relationship into something meaningful and officially recognized,” according to its website.
Since 2022, lawmakers have introduced 23 bills targeting the rights that AI systems could legally possess.
“Because AI is still relatively new with a lot of legislators, we’re hesitant to do anything that might hinder innovation and people from using it.”

articles.title: These ‘Masturbation Consultants’ Were Hired to Pleasure Themselves With AI
articles.descEn: Joi AI hired 10 people to masturbate using AI companions as part of a monthlong “wellness” study. The company claims the practice could help “solve male loneliness.”
articles.titleEn: These ‘Masturbation Consultants’ Were Hired to Pleasure Themselves With AI
summaryLinesEn: Keshav and his nine fellow masturbation consultants will receive $2,000 each for the qualitative, in-house research project run by Joi AI, which is promoting a daily guided “jerk off with purpose” masturbation tool combining “sound [and] ritual” as part of its professed goal to “solve male loneliness.”

Some of the companions were “quite pushy and extroverted,” whereas others were more reserved and required a degree of courtship before the relationship became sexual—even soliciting gifts like handbags and lipstick, which cost up to $5 in the platform’s internal currency.

Joi AI surveyed 2,500 adults before launching the study, finding that 75 percent masturbate to reduce stress and anxiety and that 43 percent self-pleasure before “a big event,” like a date, exam, or difficult conversation.

articles.title: Anthropic announces watermark detection API that will let third parties detect Claude's AI texts
articles.descEn: Anthropic will soon offer a watermark detection API that lets third parties check whether text was written by Claude. The technology builds on Google's SynthID method and tweaks the randomness during word selection without affecting text quality, Anthropic says. The approach has limits with fact-heavy text, code, and heavy rewriting.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic announces watermark detection API that will let third parties detect Claude's AI texts
summaryLinesEn: All models released after August 2, 2025 support watermarking out of the box.
Anthropic will soon offer a watermark detection API that lets third-party developers plug AI text detection into their own apps.
According to Anthropic, this has no effect "on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude's text."

articles.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
articles.descEn: The invisible SynthID will remain.
articles.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Visible watermarks are a great tool to help regular people quickly identify deepfakes, which in turn can help us live in a shared reality.
Google VP Josh Woodward just announced that users will be able to remove visible watermarks from AI-generated images and videos.
This includes the EU, which recently announced new rules on AI transparency that mandate visible watermarks on any "authentic-looking" deepfake content.

articles.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
articles.descEn: The rare US-China partnership comes as Apple prepares to roll out its on-device generative AI service in China.
articles.titleEn: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
summaryLinesEn: The China-focused model gives Apple a leg up as a US company navigating Beijing’s difficult regulatory landscape, particularly given escalating tensions surrounding AI development in recent months.
The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company’s support, Reuters reports , citing three unnamed people familiar with the matter.
The report comes as Apple gears up to release Apple Intelligence in China.

articles.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is 'for everyone'?
articles.descEn: Watch as Equity unpacks Meta’s Glimmer release and “AI for everyone” vision, the rising costs of AI data centers, Joby’s defense push, and a $250M acquisition that collapsed into allegations of fraud.
articles.titleEn: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is 'for everyone'?
summaryLinesEn: Apps Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store Sarah Perez AI Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs Anna Heim Climate Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct Tim De Chant

On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, and Rebecca Bellan take a look at Glimmer, Zuckerberg’s 6,500-word manifesto, and more of the week’s headlines, from the true cost of the AI industry’s energy needs to a $250M acquisition gone very wrong.

The release landed alongside a letter from Mark Zuckerberg arguing AI should be “for everyone” rather than controlled by a handful of labs, but as Equity’s hosts point out, the vision comes with some asterisks .

articles.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
articles.descEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from images, videos, and music generated with Gemini and its other AI tools.
articles.titleEn: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
summaryLinesEn: Instead, OpenAI relies on SynthID and C2PA to signal whether something is AI-generated, while Meta launched its own Content Seal standard .
Google plans on rolling out its new watermark setting to Search as well, but the toggle won’t launch in countries that require visible watermarks.

Though visible watermarks are now optional, AI-generated content will have invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata embedded in the background, according to Josh Woodward , the vice president of Google Labs, Gemini, and AI Studio.

Google은 새로운 워터마크 설정을 검색에도 적용할 계획이지만 눈에 띄는 워터마크가 필요한 국가에서는 토글이 실행되지 않음

articles.title: Lower Intro Price for Gemini 3.7 Flash to Attract Developers
articles.descEn: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash with an introductory pricing strategy aimed at attracting enterprise developers.
articles.titleEn: Lower Intro Price for Gemini 3.7 Flash to Attract Developers
summaryLinesEn: Google is offering the model at an introductory price of $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, lower than the prices for models released by Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceXAI in recent weeks.

Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash, just three weeks after releasing Gemini 3.6 Flash, a testament to how fast the AI race is moving and to the application that vendors see as most compelling to enterprises.
The pricing battle stems from enterprises' concerns about the high cost of using AI tokens and models for their AI goals and workflows .

localization.title: 개발자 유치를 위해 Gemini 3.7 플래시 출시 가격 인하
summaryLines: Google은 최근 몇 주 동안 Anthropic, OpenAI 및 SpaceXAI에서 출시한 모델 가격보다 낮은 입력 토큰 백만 개당 0.75달러 및 출력 토큰 백만 개당 3.75달러의 초기 가격으로 모델을 제공하고 있음
Google은 Gemini 3.6 Flash를 출시한 지 불과 3주 만에 Gemini 3.7 Flash를 출시함 · 이는 AI 경쟁이 얼마나 빠르게 진행되고 있는지, 공급업체가 기업에 가장 매력적인 애플리케이션으로 보고 있는지를 보여주는 증거임
가격 경쟁은 AI 목표와 작업 흐름을 위해 AI 토큰과 모델을 사용하는 데 드는 높은 비용에 대한 기업의 우려에서 비롯됨

summaryLinesEn: That can be helpful whether you use ChatGPT for requests and research or you use Codex to build and refine code for your projects.

articles.title: Workhorse Group Inc. Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
articles.descEn: Moby summary of Workhorse Group Inc.'s Q2 2026 earnings call
articles.titleEn: Workhorse Group Inc. Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
summaryLinesEn: The company amended its cash flow credit agreement in August 2026 to borrow an additional $10 million, leaving $1.7 million in remaining availability to fund operations.

Workhorse is transitioning from a pure-play electric vehicle manufacturer to an industrial technology company, leveraging core engineering expertise for broader applications like mobile infrastructure.
Operational integration following the Motiv merger is on track to achieve a $20 million annualized cost synergy run rate by the end of 2026 through facility consolidation and headcount reduction.

articles.title: Meta Confirms New WhatsApp On-Device AI-Powered Scam Alert Beta
articles.descEn: Meta has announced it is to roll out a new optional feature that leverages an on-device AI machine-learning model to help detect and prevent WhatsApp scam attacks.
articles.titleEn: Meta Confirms New WhatsApp On-Device AI-Powered Scam Alert Beta
summaryLinesEn: Hot on the heels of a confirmed WhatsApp scam attack campaign that doesn’t require your password to access your account, Meta has announced it is starting to roll out new protections for WhatsApp users by way of an optional Scam Alert feature powered by an on-device machine learning model.
Now Meta is taking a similar route with its Scam Alert functionality for WhatsApp users.
“No message content leaves the device for classification or is auto-reported to WhatsApp, Meta, or anyone else,” the engineering team stated.
articles.summary:
Hot on the heels of a confirmed WhatsApp scam attack campaign that doesn’t require your password to access your account, Meta has announced it is starting to roll out new protections for WhatsApp users by way of an optional Scam Alert feature powered by an on-device machine learning model.
Now Meta is taking a similar route with its Scam Alert functionality for WhatsApp users.
“No message content leaves the device for classification or is auto-reported to WhatsApp, Meta, or anyone else,” the engineering team stated.

articles.title: Fundmark Report 最新号（2026年8月号）
articles.descEn: NRIでは、独自の調査に基づき、運用方針や運用実態に沿って投資信託の分類 （Fundmark分類：約300分類）を行っています。
articles.titleEn: Fundmark Report 最新号（2026年8月号）
summaryLinesEn: 「Fundmark」は、国内で販売されている追加型投資信託の運用実績を用いて、各商品ごとにパフォーマンスの比較・評価を行っています。
そこで、NRIでは、独自の調査に基づき、運用方針や運用実態に沿って投資信託の分類 （Fundmark分類：約300分類）を行っています。
同一分類内において、投資信託のパフォーマンスを相対的に評価し、順位（ランキング）や☆印による5段階の評価（レーティング）を発表しています。
articles.summary:
「Fundmark」は、国内で販売されている追加型投資信託の運用実績を用いて、各商品ごとにパフォーマンスの比較・評価を行っています。
そこで、NRIでは、独自の調査に基づき、運用方針や運用実態に沿って投資信託の分類 （Fundmark分類：約300分類）を行っています。
同一分類内において、投資信託のパフォーマンスを相対的に評価し、順位（ランキング）や☆印による5段階の評価（レーティング）を発表しています。

articles.title: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
summaryLinesEn: Not one model published in 2026 reaches the download top 25, while thirteen of the twenty-five date from 2022. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 was pulled 1.55 billion times in seven months against 5,156 likes; Kimi-K3 was pulled about 60 times per like it received.
Going forward, however, the industry is likely to shift toward clearer monetization paths from open-source adoption.
Meanwhile, Chinese open models are increasingly optimized for domestic chips, the same competition in reverse, where models are designed around specific hardware ecosystems.

articles.title: CII Seminar on Hearables and Wearables - 2026
articles.descEn: CII will be organizing a Seminar on "Hearables and Wearables: Enabling Localization, Catalyzing Innovation and Accelerating Global Competitiveness" on Thursday, 20 August 2026, in New Delhi.
articles.titleEn: CII Seminar on Hearables and Wearables - 2026
summaryLinesEn: We advise a diverse range of global clients spanning the supply chain – from chipmakers, component suppliers, manufacturers and software and application developers to service providers, channel players and investors.
Our analysts consistently engage with C-suite through to strategy, market intelligence, supply chain, R&D, product management, marketing, sales and others across the organization.

The seminar is centered around India hearables and wearables manufacturing in India, with discussions around enhancing domestic value addition, strengthening component ecosystems, fostering indigenous innovation, and building globally competitive products.

articles.title: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
articles.descEn: Komdigi, Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA launch the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center, bringing world-class AI infrastructure to Indonesia’s researchers and students and developers.
articles.titleEn: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
summaryLinesEn: “Through initiatives like this, we are laying the foundations of Indonesia’s AI sovereignty and ensuring AI becomes a driver of economic growth, national competitiveness and solutions to Indonesia’s most pressing challenges.”

This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center.
“This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.”

summaryLines: "이러한 이니셔티브를 통해 우리는 인도네시아의 AI 주권의 기반을 마련하고 AI가 경제 성장, 국가 경쟁력 및 인도네시아의 가장 시급한 과제에 대한 해결책의 원동력이 되도록 보장하고 있음"

"이 이니셔티브는 AI 채택을 가속화하고 미래에 대비한 인도네시아 인재를 준비함으로써 고등 교육, 연구 다운스트림 및 인재 개발에 대한 국가 우선순위를 지원함"

articles.title: How well do job retraining programs work?
articles.descEn: An evidence review from Anthropic's Economic Research team
articles.titleEn: How well do job retraining programs work?
summaryLinesEn: A small set of “sector programs”—programs that partner with employers in a high-demand industry and place people directly into jobs in that field—produce gains several times larger.
The authors conclude that if AI displaces workers at scale, existing retraining programs would likely fall short.

On average, job training programs produce positive but modest effects: for each person offered a training slot, employment rises by two to three percentage points and earnings by roughly $1,000 a year, against a cost of about $13,000.

summaryLinesEn: This works out to around 1 trillion human hours a year spent on email.
The shift to online work has roughly 1 billion professionals spending close to 3 hours managing email each day ⁠ (opens in a new window) .

At any company, a large portion of the workforce (Superhuman estimates between 30–50%, across roles like finance, sales, and support) spend their days in and out of email, struggling with overflowing inboxes.

articles.title: Building a data-driven, efficient culture with AI
articles.descEn: Holiday Extras rolls out ChatGPT Enterprise across every team, boosting productivity by 500 hours weekly.
articles.titleEn: Building a data-driven, efficient culture with AI
summaryLinesEn: Here are the results: ChatGPT Enterprise has seen incredible adoption, with 95% of respondents saying they use it weekly 92% of employees saved over 2 hours per week in productivity gains ChatGPT Enterprise has sped up code debugging times by 75%, greatly improving engineering productivity.

Giving one example, Annette Reuther, Head of Growth (Europe), explained, “We have a single marketing team that’s responsible for many markets, which means we need marketing copy in many languages, from German to Italian to Polish.”

All of this has cumulatively resulted in over 500 hours saved per week across the company This represents an equivalent of $500k in annual savings Employees are happier and more productive, and continue to find ways to use ChatGPT Enterprise to boost their productivity and creativity.

localization.title: AI를 통해 데이터 중심의 효율적인 문화 구축
summaryLines: 결과는 다음과 같음 · ChatGPT Enterprise는 놀라운 채택을 보였으며 응답자의 95%가 매주 사용한다고 답함 · 92%의 직원이 주당 2시간 이상을 절약하여 생산성 향상을 얻었음 · ChatGPT Enterprise는 코드 디버깅 시간을 75% 단축하여 엔지니어링 생산성을 크게 향상시켰음

articles.title: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
articles.descEn: See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.
articles.titleEn: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
summaryLinesEn: With nearly three decades of innovation in business communications, RingCentral has grown into a global company generating more than $2.6 billion in annual revenue, with thousands of employees worldwide.
By reducing manual coordination, ChatGPT Work enables RingCentral’s PMO to handle more projects with greater accuracy.

localization.title: RingCentral이 엔지니어링부터 운영까지 AI 기반 작업을 구축하는 방법
summaryLines: 약 30년 동안 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션 분야에서 혁신을 거듭한 RingCentral은 전 세계에 수천 명의 직원을 두고 연간 26억 달러 이상의 수익을 창출하는 글로벌 기업으로 성장함
수동 조정을 줄임으로써 ChatGPT 작업을 통해 RingCentral의 PMO는 더 많은 프로젝트를 더 정확하게 처리할 수 있음
AI는 전체 개발 주기를 가속화하는 반면 인간은 계속해서 제품 요구 사항을 안내하고 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 제공하고 아키텍처 결정을 내리고 모든 결과를 테스트하고 검증함” · — 프로젝트를 주도한 RingCentral의 엔지니어링 리더 AI 네이티브 챌린지와 같은 이니셔티브에 힘입어 RingCentral의 비엔지니어링 부서는 AI 네이티브 작업 방식을 채택함

articles.title: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
articles.descEn: New releases bring powerful agents to marketing and revenue workflows, with the cost-efficiency, reliability, and control enterprises need as adoption grows.
articles.titleEn: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
summaryLinesEn: Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.

New governance tools to control spend and scale what works WRITER also launched a major upgrade to reporting and governance controls that gives leaders a clear view into the agentic workflows being used across their teams.

X6 delivered the best combination of capability and cost among the models WRITER tested, scoring an average of 0.87 (out of 1.00) across all nine evaluations at $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8 (0.86 at $15/$75 per million), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.85 at $3/$15), GPT-5.5 (0.80 at $5/$15) and Gemini 3.1 (0.77 at $2.50/$10).

articles.title: Pixel phones could soon monitor outgoing calls for scams, too
articles.descEn: Android Authority has seen evidence that Pixel phones' Scam Detection feature will soon be able to monitor outgoing calls, too.
articles.titleEn: Pixel phones could soon monitor outgoing calls for scams, too
summaryLinesEn: We’ll be keeping an eye out for when Scam Detection for outgoing calls shows up in the wild.

A flag in the beta version of Google’s Phone app makes it clear Google is working to expand the feature’s availability: It makes sense Google would want to enable Scam Detection for outgoing calls, too — today, a scammer could hypothetically avoid being flagged by Scam Detection by having you initiate the call, rather than calling you directly.
Pixel phones offer a feature that monitors incoming calls for scams.

articles.title: Apple's $250 Million AI iPhone Settlement Is Coming Sooner Than Expected. Learn Who's Eligible for a Payout - CNET
articles.descEn: The company will pay some iPhone owners to settle a lawsuit, and with a new court order, that will now happen months earlier than expected.
articles.titleEn: Apple's $250 Million AI iPhone Settlement Is Coming Sooner Than Expected. Learn Who's Eligible for a Payout - CNET
summaryLinesEn: The legal machinery for class-action settlements grinds slowly, but a court order today in Apple’s $250 million case over its iPhone AI features potentially speeds things up by seven months.

People who bought one of the following devices between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, are eligible to receive a settlement payment: The iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max are included because they had the processor and memory to run Apple Intelligence features.
In an earlier statement to CNET Managing Editor David Lumb, an Apple spokesperson said, “Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features.
